subject: Reminder: Georgia’s Primary Election is this Tuesday
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BRAD FOR GOVERNOR, INC
body:
This election is going to come down to turnout.

| | | | | [|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=785f4d2453&e=6036811227)

Friends,
This is a reminder that Georgia’s Primary Election will be held this Tuesday, May 19.
This election is going to come down to turnout, and every last vote counts. Please share this email with friends, family, and coworkers and tell them to make their voices heard.
On Tuesday, voters may cast ballots at their assigned polling location. All Georgia polling locations will be open from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
You can find your polling location and precinct here: [https://mvp.sos.ga.gov/s/](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=096fb02dfd&e=6036811227)
While Burt Jones and Rick Jackson continue spending millions attacking each other, Brad remains focused on the issues that matter most to hardworking Georgia families.
Brad is a man of faith, a proven job creator, and a conservative leader who stands on principle and puts Georgia first. As others engage in negativity and political theater, Brad continues traveling the state, listening to voters, and talking about real conservative solutions to make Georgia more affordable and safe.
Brad’s plan includes:
* Capping skyrocketing property taxes and eliminating non-essential property taxes for seniors
* Ending the state income tax on retirement benefits
* Creating great-paying jobs through re-shoring
* Fully funding state and local law enforcement
* Doubling school safety grants, including for private schools

A newly released poll conducted by Republican pollster Echelon Insights also shows Brad is the strongest Republican candidate to defeat Keisha Lance Bottoms in November.
As Democrats prepare to spend millions trying to flip Georgia blue, Republicans need a nominee with a proven ability to unite voters and win statewide.
Please make a plan to vote on Tuesday, May 19 — and encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same.
Thank you for your support, and Go Brad!Team Raffensperger

subject: Trump wants to end mail-in voting forever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. With MAGA angling for total control, Trump wants to end their use forever.
Fuel our work with $35 or more right now to help defend the use of mail-in ballots across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051726_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051726_3&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051726_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=051726_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=051726_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=051726_3&amount=50]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can to fight their unending desire for control and protect mail-in voting? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=051726_3&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: Tomorrow Could Determine Whether Voters Get a Choice
body:
Chip in ahead of deadline!

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Friends,
Tomorrow is a critical day for our campaign.
We are fighting to protect our place on the ballot and ensure that New Yorkers have the opportunity to decide this race at the ballot box.
This campaign was built around a simple belief: voters deserve a real choice and a real debate about affordability, housing, transit, economic opportunity, and whether public money is truly working for working people.
But right now, procedural challenges threaten to cut that debate short before voters ever get their say.
We are continuing to fight because democracy works best when people have choices, not when grassroots campaigns are pushed aside before Election Day arrives.
Legal fights like this move quickly and require real resources. If you believe New Yorkers deserve a choice in this race, we need your help right now.

[Please chip in today to help us defend ballot access and keep this movement moving forward!](https://ademfornewyork.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=81a9f685946c3d17fe402b3fb&id=412d96056e&e=5702859c35)
In solidarity,Adem

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

My wife and I have lived through seven miscarriages. One of them came just months after the Dobbs decision. We were sitting in a doctor's office for a 10-week ultrasound when the doctor told us the fetus was forming without a head, there was no heartbeat, _and could only help**because** there was no heartbeat._
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d38716c6-1377-49d1-922c-d2f9bdadc531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some of you have followed this fight since I ran against Andy Ogles. The lines have changed, redistricting put us in a new district, but the fight hasn't. Different name on the door, same broken ideology inside. Now I'm running against Scott DesJarlais, and everything I said then is just as true today, because DesJarlais has spent over a decade in Congress wrapping himself in the pro-life label like a shield. **But then there 's what he actually did.**
Actual **court documents** show that DesJarlais pressured a mistress to get an abortion. The same man who wants the federal government to make that decision for your family couldn't live by those convictions himself when it was inconvenient for him.
Let that sink in. This isn't about attacking someone's personal struggles. Lord knows my family has had enough of those. **This is about honesty.** This is about who gets to sit in that room with you.
**My wife and I didn 't have the luxury of hypocrisy. **We faced that impossible moment for real. And then we fought back, through IVF, through hope, through our son Killian, who is 18 months old and the strongest boy I know. Nobody handed us a rating. Nobody gave us an endorsement.
We just lived it, and we know thousands of families across the nation are living it too. **[If you could show support to my campaign by CLICKING HERE, you'll keep us fighting for the medical rights every person should have:](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ee6c2c1c-2e7b-476b-914c-922bddddc28e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Chip in Today, Anything Helps](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ee6c2c1c-2e7b-476b-914c-922bddddc28e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/72f5bd33-1d11-47fc-8257-95a785f27998?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

At a time when everything is getting more expensive, we need leaders that protect workers and fight to lower costs. _**That's why I'm supporting Christina Stephenson for Labor Commissioner.**_

name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: Good News for Eastern Oregon and Rural Communities
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
Too often, decisions made in Washington ignore the people who actually live and work in these communities.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,This week, the Trump Administration rescinded the Biden-era "Conservation and Landscape Health Rule," commonly known as the Public Lands Rule.For many communities across eastern Oregon and rural parts of our state, this is welcome news.The Biden-era rule created serious concerns because it expanded the ability of federal agencies to restrict productive uses of public lands, including grazing, mining, energy development, and other activities that support rural economies and working families. The federal government has a responsibility to manage public lands responsibly, but it also has a responsibility to recognize that these lands are tied directly to the livelihoods of Oregonians.**Too often, decisions made in Washington ignore the people who actually live and work in these communities.** I've spent years working with local leaders, timber interests, agricultural communities, and federal partners on issues involving wildfire recovery, forest management, and economic development. I understand how deeply connected these issues are to jobs, community stability, recreation, water access, and long-term recovery in rural Oregon. [Can You Chip In Now?](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-y/) Conservation and economic activity are not mutually exclusive. Oregon can protect natural resources while still supporting the industries and communities that depend on access to public lands.What frustrated many Oregonians about the prior rule was the growing sense that local voices no longer mattered and that federal agencies were gaining more authority with less accountability.That approach does not work for Oregon.As Governor, I will continue pushing for balanced land management policies that respect rural communities, support responsible economic activity, and ensure that decisions affecting Oregon are not made without Oregon voices at the table.With Election Day almost here, this campaign continues building momentum across every part of the state, including communities that have felt ignored for far too long.If you believe Oregon needs leadership that understands both our natural resources and the people whose lives depend on them, [I'd be grateful for your support.](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-j/)Thank you,**Danielle Bethell
Republican for Governor****P.S.** Rural Oregon deserves a Governor who will fight to make sure local communities are heard instead of sidelined by federal bureaucracy. If you'd like to help us continue reaching voters across the state before May 19, [please chip in here today.](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-t/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-i/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-d/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-h/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-k/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-fb-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-tw-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-m/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-li-auldyjd-hhlrhljhit-c/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-auldyjd-l-q)

## Navy Jets Collide at Idaho Air Show
Two U.S. Navy EA-18G Growler jets [collided midair](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAYBODT2B0WBmNwQfEad3ntlhaBH_NH2ERAwub2K-8Vth5pRt983babwYjn_t8coKtP2wmtRKgV8uZxDxXyA2qxKUZ0kKKDUp8bo2wmVJBRbc5g_GxT77QHYMB70KOUC12UFLwPWpnRyVmM3AmpZiWlkYKaSclpWe5whx711UbFqEZKhaADvxvJhV-UodJza7uJgsOa8vBIeNYAPn7SG_Jg09FHHWp9lo7_69jasbW1Nvj0fSmuvGPrq3RsrS2Ry0FsNiUQ98p47gSdCYkYzKSE1AgckHc47YfYDK2Q_CqBFAsn9Fm7Z8MYscyym-h-GIy_-_VPp701-wkAAP__PLODHQ) during an aerial demonstration at the Gunfighter Skies Air Show at Idaho's Mountain Home Air Force Base on Sunday afternoon. All four crew members ejected and were being evaluated by medical personnel. Video shared by spectators shows the two electronic warfare jets flying close together before locking together in midair, pitching upward, and cartwheeling to the ground as four parachutes deploy. The aircraft exploded on impact about two miles northwest of the base. [Watch the video here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0Ltu6kAQxvGnWXeg8V7tYgvOQY5SkBalsgbv2F60vsg7QHj7CF4h7Vd8-ul_PrUnjCnOwxdO5Llf2pkeOREzbW0fh5FpuxLnbkkpBlpSoMxrK0HaHZhdWbUBY3q2ugi-J5KkCvKlczXUlTOqGD1ip7UsgzWoS3tRqqpdXSuLhCZckIroX29gyqoEMAb26oJOmb6uEFyvuk5ooBB52fbXJc48Up-ey522fbdMRfIj85qFOgjZCNn8vFYhmzd43m7DIGSTGfmWhWwkGAu1stKAddqAhlKoJgt11FZIi9Mq1D8W6uiqzxn-3-fV0Ydbz9_H2HbmUGw-rI-YUszWCQ3DhDG9GfyndncvfwMAAP__gL5-cA). The jets were part of the [Navy's Growler Demonstration Team](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb8GO3eeCIIFRRq7TZvSeQsPZcOKA2Qd_z5jfiHVbe7cO-d83ec7hhi25RNfZKpP80ZHiVQr5dmHZa2Un1SLTTEGRyk6KnWfOfChBdl2enYY4jmLxhlPxKlvyHRKjTBqJftmNQ-rpcJRd-KBfrQgtJAghR3kAJ4PXRPMtQay0x2AlHDrH6h66UeNoHxvLRNALtSUb88UtrqSj2d6U77Z9GqiWWvdC-s_GJ8YnyqWb9zc_pP3VOiqMD5dTFfg-2yXnI5IubQ2Y1lbDLms6WB8arJx-xFiDGVQTMDywhD_Puq_xLwN_w0AAP__ViZ4dg), based at Naval Air Station Whidbey Island in Washington state. ## Grads Boo AI Talk at Commencements
Graduating students at multiple universities have spent the past week [booing commencement speakers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOyYIIlhQbGP3b7ulQbjonSAYvTMT337jvMJfn-Tk-86_n-nHY8ay_PUbOEp1KvA5MxDBMSVcVoLjCXSGmjNGqDnCSfskhey50Ly1U_SYr6lroksAElQDrjVmEIM1WjWrAyOCmK2CoO0g42zn3htlVNf7FKWVDbrbJnRrWyG0Fg81e6N0GqwXJqkQWCcgItXj8axYaIWUr_qG4xHq1mS3Eu0nU3-YHJkcCcIajlcJ642ZHG85k6PQTI6tYXLExK_6OoAv-MaycM9D3TYoATYoxM8dIKwcC_-e3Pw1A4-1EL8x1sI9Mjk2h4v7B3PGszesE8vmMX8X0a8yvp38HwAA___ajYX5) who tried to celebrate artificial intelligence. At the University of Central Florida, real estate executive Gloria Caulfield was interrupted by jeers when she called AI "the next industrial revolution." Stunned, she turned to the other speakers on stage and asked, _"What happened?"_ Former [Google CEO Eric Schmidt](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpDAQhU9jMrf8gxsIHGxCNptuiNx2ATWyKWTXznTv6Vf0FSZ9T_rez5-P5SNgxmP7HQp4Xmk54LtlYIa6rLjtDPUTuEXKGRNQTtD4XIwyd6mc1OOSAubX0nfJrwAGbAdeD8OkpnFwttu9Ng-tJtuvNo0AvZ7AJmeSHu0dHFjTob9oyulRK-WcutlHGKxbpzGoYbUxil5BQqZ6-yQ8eIc1v-gL6i1S6bLfmc8m7C9hZmHm43VS48sSZr7AwszKCTPrQZj5b5PXPmFmeMqNaMsgI5CEilG2uBdMLB9EkGRgGSr-oyPISKXAEaHAwfJKlgFlg6fcQw2tveWYA5YL3FWfzm_MGdt9EL3aSsD8rso_-vfLm_8BAAD__2bhj88) got an even rougher reception at the University of Arizona on Saturday, where boos grew loud enough to drown him out when he told graduates they would "help shape artificial intelligence." The pushback reflects growing anxiety about AI's impact on the entry-level job market, with critics warning the technology could obliterate opportunities for new graduates. A recent [Gallup poll](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQheGnMZ3RYK-xKVykobtpU6LBHsCbASPsuxvePtq8QuojHX36f31NX5g4HetP3MnXJU8HvQtTrXRNS1q3SteTagmZOUXKHKnUc1KgeglGdm6KmPieHk30C5Ei3ZDvrB1gcNboZvNGzzYYMKCDi2i63mkzL4SDnuegwDbJf97AdK4DMAZaPaPVZhkcgl10COIBFFPNV_vM6agbLXznF11tyHvDfqv1LEL_EGoUavzw2xWZv8_PLtR4ZmahRgvO9SDUeOfvY5W405UCHkU-8yx3vH5TlSeVkvZUdlkqHrHIlfOMzHeL5fzTXD6e78ScSm_FA9YdE_9D1P8q9_LqbwAAAP__hZ6EOw) found only 43% of Americans aged 15 to 34 think it's a good time to find a job locally, down from 75% in 2022.
## Oldest English Poem Found in Roman Library
Researchers from Trinity College Dublin have identified a 9th-century manuscript in Rome's national library as [the third-oldest surviving copy](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL_GzhhhMAYCgksm20svtBhoxr1qg4X7duW_P_l-YcNSSaV678_H-hGRsL5_xx0Cl7ZW-D4JmKGvBd8bQ_8EPlMjwgyNMpx8rEqqRUgjJrfmiHSt85hDAVCgRwiTtV56Z40et_CCnJOJJiULVmvjXJoVFJ1VnozTfsRwr0kzuUlKY-RDv6LVpngXpS06pWGWkJFbf3w2rLxBoat9QX-kto8UNubjHPSvQT0H9YzHDXBXd-iMiWBQz0ZZQH0TnpvYY_17po4Hi6MB90u8IINIEfLeqtiuvQqKjFUgR7rEJBe7-CSn2cspFblkF83itM9micnLsYd8fCMRnosdZvneI9L_c_wjo19B_QsAAP__R2mK0w) of _Caedmon's Hymn_ , widely considered the first poem written in English. Dated to between 800 and 830, it's the oldest known version where Old English appears in the main body of the text, rather than [scrawled in the margins](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQBeDTmC7IPzgDhYtt6LLtlshrj4OjAUf2KCi3X5ErbDfF6H1P7-e23HymvN-__YaOU1l2PBohM9Yl5fvKWB_ILRSiHLFQxMbPRUt9vUh7UeMSfab3MnTRJUSNpkOnACY5jWBNt7o0QJSg_AQDor3CFOKo_JgUakheQ5fdmSatGpWU1sre_HowNk2jl5BMCGKQGDOX2j9K3nnFRO_ywtqHsnXkVuZnE-ZL6Fno-TiOvoWMe8BPs_NJ6LkioW_YhJ5PTehZ2vM-XauNMQb6lbeuuvg8MlFuVxCDvG8-08fhf43zcvovAAD__-bhdhs). The nine-line hymn praises God for creating the world and is said to have been composed in the 7th century by Caedmon, an illiterate Northumbrian cowherd who, according to legend, was given the gift of song in a dream and sang the verses on the spot. The book was transcribed in a northern Italian abbey, then had vanished for centuries, and passed through European collectors and a New York rare-book dealer before Italy bought it back in 1972. [Read the poem here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGuozAQgOHTQAcaTIyhcLENXbbdEjl4jCcabGTPJsrtn967wrvA_0vfv_t2d8SUjr_uRCshbwnflVEEyxboiILliVL3zEweM3uscm0K1NSB7oZ58474s91abwOiwrFFOxizwDIbPbbRAgCExwzoJq_NAFrBODm1BGWUWXZsyX7XQA_zAKA19OPDmVGHZXZgwrjvzQ3Qk-TSPzMliRj4k19Y-j2fLdsoctVm_NOotVErne7AZ_5fkuM-l6NRqytCO2Oj1t2hP3OqXfycqZOIXaBSpcN0MNXYXRmlLdZfb2KmOpnmBsfpiH9W8iufl1VfAQAA__-bP3sp).

Oldest English Poem Found in Roman Library Researchers from Trinity College Dublin have identified a 9th-century manuscript in Rome's national library as of Caedmon's Hymn , widely considered the first poem written in English. Dated to between 800 and 830, it's the oldest known version where Old English appears in the main body of the text, rather than . The nine-line hymn praises God for creating the world and is said to have been composed in the 7th century by Caedmon, an illiterate Northumbrian cowherd who, according to legend, was given the gift of song in a dream and sang the verses on the spot. The book was transcribed in a northern Italian abbey, then had vanished for centuries, and passed through European collectors and a New York rare-book dealer before Italy bought it back in 1972. . # **The 2026 "Trump Effect"
on IRAs over $50,000**
---
**President Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” is exactly what this country needs.** It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s finally putting American families first. But we have to be honest with you about something that’s hard to say. **Trump’s new plan is moving fast** ... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle. Think of it like a powerful cleaning crew coming into a dusty old house. They are going to scrub everything clean, which is wonderful. But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. He is doing his job. **But the Wall Street banks holding your retirement savings are like those shaky tables.** They are old, tired, and not built for this kind of _**Economic Revolution**._ If you leave your money sitting there, it could get caught in the shake-up.
---
**This is why we hesitate to share this next part publicly.**
---
There is a way to move your **_financial heirloom_** to a safe room before the cleaning starts. It involves a specific, IRS-approved loophole that very few families know about. **To be honest, this loophole works so well it may feel a little unfair**. It allows you to quietly step out of the chaotic banking system to figuratively _**lock** _your savings into something that doesn't care about stock markets or bank failures. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. While your neighbors are glued to the TV worrying about the next market swing, you can turn the TV off, knowing your grandkid's inheritance is sitting in a sanctuary that Wall Street can't touch.
---
# **[We’ve written down exactly how to use this loophole inside our 2026 Patriot’s Wealth Defense Guide.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
This kind of protection is typically only whispered about by the ultra-wealthy. But with the speed of Trump's changes, we feel a moral duty to share it with those who need to help protect their families. **If you are an American Citizen with more than $50,000 in retirement, you may already be eligible to receive the benefits detailed in this free guide.** [**Note: We also currently have a Silver Allocation Incentive*.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) body:
I wanted to personally reach out as we head into Election Day.

| | | | |
---
| | Friends,
I wanted to personally reach out as we head into Election Day.The last several months have been an incredible journey - traveling across Kentucky, meeting voters in every corner of the Commonwealth, and building a campaign centered on the people of this state. I’ve had the privilege of seeing firsthand the energy, support, and belief so many Kentuckians have in Daniel Cameron and his vision for Kentucky.
As we close out this primary campaign, I’d love to invite you to join us on Election Night as we gather with friends, supporters, and members of our campaign team to watch the results come in together.
**Daniel Cameron Election Night Watch Party****Tuesday, May 19th****6:00 PM****Chapel 1888****108 W. Jefferson****La Grange, KY 40031**
Campaigns are built by people who show up: those who volunteer, pray, encourage, bring friends, and help spread the word. Whether you’ve been with us from day one or joined along the way, _we’d love to have you with us for this special evening_.
I hope you’ll join Daniel, Makenze, our team, and supporters from across Kentucky as we finish this race together.
Thank you for all you’ve done.
Sincerely,Nathanael HirtCampaign ManagerDaniel Cameron for U.S. Senate

body:
Make a plan to vote tomorrow
| | | | | [](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jIZ7COHDakdefdIjIv_8JOXMWEY8t1xP-vwp_fqrC2QtObvhSVWI_c_I8kN08aVlN1DY3NzJWtiG4EdJeCOWdAVcD33VJ2izWbRJCSANV26uCdUTmtMGliakZqbvsQOkmDK-m_NrzNkVGtO_AoRAv9fOaj9wKV6M&c=021aBBqQEn4zgFR-VHyqvdO8J4dEM4Nl0fJps6Sa633WoNE2eM6yXQ==&ch=a40J3ggUy5SpJrXIBozj6hRuFIAwecbe-w_agb9KYtLi18wj-Ej9xA==)

| It's hard to believe it, but we're finally here: tomorrow is Election Day.
While we have the momentum, we need every single vote. We ran this race on our record, while our opponent ran this race on smears. While there was plenty to share about our opponent, we stayed focused on my record of delivering and our Georgia common sense values. Tomorrow will be the ultimate test of whether our strategy worked and whether this district rejects Hollywood style tactics.
Polls are open tomorrow (May 19th) from 7:00 AM until 7:00 PM. Make a plan today for when you plan to vote.
Democrats account for more than 57% of the early vote statewide. That is very concerning for our statewide Supreme Court and Court of Appeals judge races. These races are not primaries--it's the general election, and the left is trying to politicize our courts and put liberal activists on the bench. Don't let it happen--vote for our Supreme Court and Court of Appeals incumbent judges. Be sure to go all the way down the ballot--judicial races are after the party ballot questions.
And please don't forget to encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to head to the polls!

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1931, Texas lawmakers established a five-member committee to [investigate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGyoyAUxvGnwU4HzkWEgmIbu2y7pXMMR2UGJQMnMb79TvIKt_pX36_4_t2mG8YUj_Uv7uT5veTpoLMmYqYyLbnsVOKxI9NaMDyRqdb85AkkmFb2rbJTwJiuSTfBzzI41ZBXw-CUBKVNs3mNup-d6-8OQDo9W3QalKVAM1rTmyb6DyZ7ZZWSAKazRvXyZ1ic0VbfcRFaUoicS8cbMb2xLunKLyrdPe9N8hvzo4qfPwJGAeN5nh3XDfOR4kFdLquA8btqA17tfH0iYKSDy6dOQ1N8eJwxpVjNILRcd4zpi_PvLnl5-B8AAP__SoF1TQ) all aspects of state government, aiming to streamline operations and cut costs. The legislature never acted on the committee's recommendations, which would have saved an estimated $6 million a year. Today is the first day of early voting for the Republican and Democratic [runoff elections](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAUhJ9GMyz-BA0INjG7m25onZGDUoVAAY4zb7818wo37-7q7_v3s_6ADz7uf-FE014urRHvGrA1LKtL5cTi4wkN9wL2goa1pqutnHJF6EjYtFrw4b3K3poHtTPr0TCtZ0Y5k6o_jBP8IdSoNJfzQ6ppo8iFFWKjWrvZ0t6bzxgd2cQY5VwNk2IjFdrNSk5yA9dJita3VIZ2YMMXVBfe6Yll2NLZB3O0lmsn_nR86fhy3_fg0kvDVZuPn0jHlw9Tx5dvmZQrJufIBmcGv8dKcsEMBYnzEQLJVz0IQglv8kzNx51AziXBdmDti7H59iH4qnQn6X6CD98b7Xfynob_DwAA__-vG4ab). Are you planning to vote early? Hit reply to let us know. The FBI is [offering](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAQRk9jd0SAHWIXFNuk-7fd0prAkIyEwRrGcXz7VfYKW3_Sp_fen5_lByhTef6GFb18Ul0KHi2jCPKSKq_IVFYQfDLEHQRbq7ssVlun9FWZaYlA-VzGPvqHjrPp0ZvbbTbamtH1L5_s7LQZkoXHcJ0QDEYLKQ3BzsEE7Xry3zN9NZMx2lp3mZy56uGWZjdOY4DUjRojSeWLvFDwAy3ls76RL6GuffYvka11w6_O3jt7P47jkurna_HdO3vfW2fvQKxS5YCKimBWbxQFOeMTYz5V24ghY1TEUJQgc2W1l4h8VM5RCa2YqaCKGJBEvfYiqm2nanvbMEjPPm4H5UzN3bpRP1eg_A9P_i_q29u_AQAA___mM5Ct) a $200,000 reward for information that leads to the arrest and prosecution of Monica Witt, a former U.S. Air Force intelligence specialist believed to have defected to Iran. Witt, 47, was born in El Paso and enlisted in the Air Force at the age of 18. Witt was assigned to an RC-135 reconnaissance airplane crew before studying Farsi at the U.S. Defense Language Institute in Monterey, California. She [received access](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAUhZ8GO04A5ceCYhq7O-2UBmWjO0ExsM_1nrefOK8w7Vor60u-P1_zV8CM5_Y7HODpJ5X5hLtlIII6p1IPqHgegWCrIb4DQWvlTbMSynChuXRzDJg_89BFv4g4yg68tHaUQsnBdLvXyrregRPGuiUmo62GJY1idVYkoZYO_XMmtHRSCqXMyxmpRW_TaAY3rCGxQUBEKvVFOxD8hJbyp3xDfa3l6LLfia7G-l9MTUxNtMOOOT8dU9NVMq4fpqYzEJYzZN5gfVekJ9POiV73_CgnroHfSMSxhpNDu57xBjxg5anUFXhakFe4Q41MTV318boxZ2zGskFsR8B_yI7-T-K3V38DAAD__-hmhz4) to classified information and deployed to several locations in the Middle East before leaving the Air Force in 2008. In 2012, Witt attended the anti-Western International Conference on Hollywoodism in Tehran, where she allegedly disclosed military intelligence with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. As many of you know, I left the Democratic Party in 2021 to start the Forward Party, a positive independent political movement dedicated to reforming our broken politics via changes to the primary system, ranked choice voting and helping aligned candidates - of any party - win. We have a soft spot for Independents - now reflecting 49% of the population - as we believe candidates from outside the traditional system are necessary for real reform. Forward Party today has dozens of elected officials nationwide and tens of thousands of members and is endorsing a small army of candidates this November. My co-chairs are Gov. Christie Todd Whitman, former Governor of New Jersey, and Lt. Gov. Kerry Healey of Massachusetts, two leaders who left the Republican Party. We are building what much of the country wants.
This week on the podcast, I interview Paul Rieckhoff, one of the leaders of the independent political movement and the founder of Independent Veterans of America. Military veterans are often independents, as they are more about a spirit of service to the country than partisan politics. "If America is a religion, veterans are its clergy" is a quote I picked up from Paul.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31647700-eb19-4119-80de-671d8ab5bc32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I reflected on my experience leaving the Democratic Party in my recent book, "Hey Yang, Where's my Thousand Bucks?" Here's an excerpt:
**Chapter 24 - Leaving the Party**
When 'Forward' came out at the end of 2021, I left the Democratic Party. I put out a little social media video and a brief blog post saying I was now an Independent.
People lost their minds.
It made national headlines. Millions of people googled me. Millions read the blog post - I wished I had been more lengthy and prosaic in my explanation.
I got accused of being a wannabe Fox anchor, a grifter, a loser, a whiner, out to profit by selling books and on and on.
It was very odd.
The bookselling thing was particularly weird. You don't actually make a ton of money on books most of the time, and Democrats are big book buyers. Trying to become a gazillionaire as an author by leaving the Dems would be insane. How much am I getting paid to write this book? I don't even know, but let's just say it's not paying for anyone's college tuition. Maybe enough to buy some textbooks? Tell you what, I hereby pledge to donate all proceeds from this book to an anti-poverty org or democracy reform. Now you can tell others about it and know that the money is going someplace good! This pledge isn't hard to make because, again, there isn't that much money at stake, unless this book becomes a megahit, at which point I retract this pledge and will instead bathe in the money.
I had been a CNN contributor up through this time. I was getting paid something pretty significant - about $125,000 a year - to be exclusive to them. Evelyn thought it was the best job I'd ever had. "You just talk for a few minutes and they pay you? Keep that job!!" It was a lot easier going on air when they just ask you your opinion on something than as a candidate. They offered me a contract to return at the end of my mayoral run.
Then the news came out that I was no longer a Democrat. My agent called me and said, "Hey, CNN is rescinding its offer to you. Apparently they don't want to be seen as supporting a third party."
I responded, "Wouldn't that make me more valuable to them, not less, in that I'd be an objective voice that isn't tied up in one party or the other?"
"They don't think so."
"Huh. Okay."
It felt like rejection from a company that I thought really liked me.
So there was a lot of blowback when I left the Democratic Party. I was more mystified by it than anything else. This was just me doing what I thought was the right thing. It was clear to me that our two-party system was just going to get worse and more polarized and wasn't going to fix itself.
On the TV front, I thought, "Okay, I guess this means I can go on any network. That's cool." Fox started asking me to come on all of the time.
I went on a couple times but became uncomfortable when a lot of it was, "Boy, those Democrats sure suck, don't they!?! Tell us more Yang, you're a former Democrat, why'd you leave those idiots?" I left the Democratic Party because I had become convinced that their approach wasn't going to work, but it wasn't like I thought Fox and the Republicans were the answer.
It was a lesson; in order to feed the narrative machine, it paid to be on one side or the other. That's where the energy was. That's where the money was.
I, of course, wasn't really motivated by that. But it definitely made me understand what other people go through when they're trying to do something a little bit different outside the machine.
During this time, my phone rang. It was Dave Chappelle. We are friends but he doesn't often just call out of the blue.
"Hey man, I just called to say it's inspiring to see someone do something that is actually courageous. I never see that happen. But seeing you do it makes me feel like there's still some character left in the world. So thank you."
I guess he'd heard that I'd left the party and was taking shit for it.
"Thanks Dave. That means a lot." And it did. Take it from a guy who walked away from $50 million to do a comedy show with his name on it.
Dave's call was a pick-me-up. But my response to the blowback I was getting was kind of contrarian and stubborn - it made me feel like I was on the right track.
And I was confident I'd find others like me who didn't think the current path was going to work.
One of those people was Paul Rieckhoff.
For my conversation with Paul Rieckhoff, the host of Independent Americans, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/fdcdeef9-20f6-4210-a59e-c976b536eec1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). | | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DaElfN08ro7O7EHPHsV3_UDeWTXYfHW0hMi6IGTkbvMsro19hFuQYWkcNU70FfrKTwyRCZna7ueVwp0rpR_rMucTVRftJOy2xDpN_uh1NWH3U_pULBJa22kw-2UeHAOJbqyWnFsIjWt-sKXIXRe5qp986ZWdslbb5clh1pq-UesIkmHnDg5XZucAshF21fjvKuWEqGevI_CQmZbKYiPrRxcYr2cdAXD6J8iz_babh44=&c=KOtEHalyLQWBHXOrWH8vx1boEiS5Bbz2QY-Q_8L6j-SAgb2aLAIXxg==&ch=0FazTDpbTR25Cw34AR1MR3f7Kl5SdGXXf5ZF0VXib62ZDsYB3q7o2w==)

|
Peter,
The early voting numbers out of Georgia are extraordinary.
Nearly one million voters turned out before the early voting window closed Friday. Democrats hold a 15-point advantage -- flipping the script on 2022, when Republicans held a similar early voting lead and went on to win every statewide office.
The surge is real. The momentum is ours.
And it may not be enough.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DaElfN08ro7O7EHPHsV3_UDeWTXYfHW0hMi6IGTkbvMsro19hFuQYWkcNU70FfrKTwyRCZna7ueVwp0rpR_rMucTVRftJOy2xDpN_uh1NWH3U_pULBJa22kw-2UeHAOJbqyWnFsIjWt-sKXIXRe5qp986ZWdslbb5clh1pq-UesIkmHnDg5XZucAshF21fjvKuWEqGevI_CQmZbKYiPrR4AtxP4RTzGzHcC9p-0ohM4=&c=KOtEHalyLQWBHXOrWH8vx1boEiS5Bbz2QY-Q_8L6j-SAgb2aLAIXxg==&ch=0FazTDpbTR25Cw34AR1MR3f7Kl5SdGXXf5ZF0VXib62ZDsYB3q7o2w==)
---
Here is what we know about Georgia that the headline numbers don't show.
Republican Election Day turnout in Georgia is historically massive. A high-profile U.S. Senate primary is almost certain to drive Republicans to the polls tomorrow in force. In 2022, Democrats had early voting momentum too -- and it wasn't enough.
This is not a moment to exhale. This is the moment that decides everything. MAGA understands what is at stake in Georgia better than most Democrats do.
This is the state where dark money networks connected to Leonard Leo did their dry run -- challenging the validity of 364,000 votes in the Warnock-Ossoff Senate runoff. They failed because their data was bad. DHS has since seized voter records in Georgia's most Democratic counties to fix that problem.
This is the state where Trump personally called election officials and instructed them to find him more votes. This is the state where Governor Kemp just announced a special session to gerrymander two Democratic congressional districts out of existence before 2028.
That gerrymander will end up in front of the Georgia Supreme Court.
The same court that is on the ballot tomorrow. The same court whose conservative incumbents -- Warren and Bethel -- already looked the other way when Trump tried to steal Georgia's 2020 election.
A win tomorrow puts pro-democracy justices on the path to a majority on that court before 2028. Before Kemp's maps come up for review. Before MAGA's vote-challenge operation needs a friendly court to rubber-stamp what they're building. A loss means Warren and Bethel are there for all of it.
We are 2-0. Pennsylvania. Wisconsin. Tomorrow we go 3-0. Then on Wednesday, the fight to Unpack Our Courts and rebalance the Supreme Court of the United States begins in full.
But we cannot show up to that fight having left anything on the field in Georgia.
Every dollar raised in the next 24 hours goes directly to Election Day turnout operations reaching voters right now, today, tonight, before the polls open tomorrow morning:
[Can we count on you to rush a donation of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare to make sure the 15-point early voting lead holds when Republicans flood the polls tomorrow?](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DaElfN08ro7O7EHPHsV3_UDeWTXYfHW0hMi6IGTkbvMsro19hFuQYWkcNU70FfrKp7ukiItILDIRihTrWepFVXkP0QzyDfV_ZBDoCZZlRpj19km0qnEkXH47bQO7HBayGdklw6YPu6GGyIKjslTcpgdRK2RwpK8FuSMeEUHkPwvEkD9O5TCcDU5ijrSrt7vb3kMczp4GLhT2RbOBW5_g_0kNhXga_ZA-SNX_VIQYamKXxSggUtUNQZvvnOaRAK2p&c=KOtEHalyLQWBHXOrWH8vx1boEiS5Bbz2QY-Q_8L6j-SAgb2aLAIXxg==&ch=0FazTDpbTR25Cw34AR1MR3f7Kl5SdGXXf5ZF0VXib62ZDsYB3q7o2w==)

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. We launched our campaign for Congress with a belief that our community deserves better and a scrappiness that’s unique to Michigan’s 10th. I knew this journey would require sacrifice, and I also knew it would come with incredible moments. I want to share my favorite part of this experience with you:
It’s the conversations that stay with you.
Sometimes those conversations are hard. Seniors worried about rising grocery costs and threats to Social Security. Working parents doing everything they can to stay afloat while giving their kids the best life possible. A neighbor quietly sharing concerns about her mother’s recent cancer diagnosis.
Sometimes those conversations are full of joy: “I’ve never actually had a politician knock on my door before!” “My daughter is starting at Michigan in the fall!” “DEEETROIT BASKETBALL!”
These moments are my favorite part of this race because they remind me why this campaign matters. At the end of the day, people want to know that someone in Washington is listening and willing to fight for them. These conversations also remind me that even in difficult times, we can still build something better together for our families, our communities, and our future.
We’re less than 80 days out to the primary election, and it takes $250 a day to keep our door-to-door campaign running. If the first ten people who read this email donate $25, we can make sure we fill up our staff’s gas tanks to travel to events and outfit them with megaphones and clipboards. Will you chip in today? This past year has changed me, and I feel grateful for every person who has shown up, shared their story, volunteered, donated, or believed in what we’re building together.
And the best part is that we’re just getting started. Together, we’re going to fight to lower costs, protect working families, defend our democracy, and deliver the leadership this district deserves.
So if you want to be part of what it takes to actually win this race, I’m asking you to step up today. Your support helps us knock on more doors, have more conversations, and reach the voters who will decide this election. subject: [Take The Poll] Do you approve of the USPS sending guns through the mail?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends —
The U.S. Postal Service could be on the verge of allowing handguns through the mail. As one of GIFFORDS’s top supporters, we want to hear from you:
Team: Should the USPS follow Donald Trump’s command and legalize sending guns through the mail?
| | **[YES](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_USPS_poll_q22026//?source=em260518-1-b&refcode2=11476.3935704.m06dma&akid=11476%2E3935704%2Em06dma)**
---
| **[NO](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_USPS_poll_q22026//?source=em260518-1-b&refcode2=11476.3935704.m06dma&akid=11476%2E3935704%2Em06dma)**
---
For nearly 100 years, federal law has banned the people’s postal service from carrying or delivering guns through the mail with very few exceptions.
Donald Trump and the gun lobby want to change that: Earlier this year, the Department of Justice announced they would no longer be enforcing that ban.
Now, the U.S. Postal Service is debating a rule change that could lift this ban entirely. This could have grave effects for our country.
If this goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and have a gun mailed to them — including those with felony convictions.
This change also means that gun traffickers have a new and comprehensive way to move firearms through America’s communities.
[**Please vote in our new USPS poll today:**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_USPS_poll_q22026//?source=em260518-1-b&refcode2=11476.3935704.m06dma&akid=11476%2E3935704%2Em06dma)

---
Thank you,
GIFFORDS

[ **Sign the No Amnesty Petition** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
You see, right now, a group of **RINO Republicans** —led by Rep. Maria Salazar—is trying to jam through one of the most dangerous immigration bills we’ve seen in years. At first they called it the “DIGNITY Act,” and then to slap you in the face they changed it to the “ _DIGNIDAD_ Act.” That’s right, the bill’s name is in actually in Spanish. But don’t be fooled by the word Dignity—or _Dignidad_ —because this bill is just a **Trojan Horse for mass amnesty.** It would **let MILLIONS of illegal immigrants stay in America—legally, and reward those who have illegally lived here the longest.** It would **hand out work permits on a massive scale—even to people who broke our laws to get here.** It would **flood the job market with more foreign labor—putting pressure on American wages.** And worst of all... It would **tie the hands of law enforcement—making deportations nearly impossible once someone applies.** That’s not border security. That’s surrender. And the worst part is...this isn’t coming from Democrats. This betrayal is coming from **Republicans who KNOW BETTER.** Maria Salazar can call it “Dignidad” all she wants—but giving legal status to people who broke our laws is the very definition of AMNESTY. And conservatives across the country are sounding the alarm, warning this bill would **undermine President Trump’s mass deportation mandate** and reward illegal behavior instead of ending it Friend, think about what this really means: While President Trump and Tom Homan are fighting to restore law and order, and while ICE agents are risking their lives to enforce the law...RINOs in Congress are working behind the scenes to **shut it all down.** If this passes, deportations could grind to a halt. Millions could be allowed to stay. And the floodgates could open wide again. That’s why we cannot stay silent. Every patriotic AMERICAN CITIZEN must make their voice heard. **[Please—sign your EMERGENCY NO AMNESTY PETITION right now and help us send a message loud enough that even the weakest Republicans can’t ignore it:](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** NO AMNESTY.
NO EXCUSES.
NO MORE BETRAYAL.
---
[ **No Amnesty!** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
We need a tidal wave of patriots thousands of patriots standing up and saying: We voted for **mass deportations**. We voted for **law and order**. We did NOT vote for backroom deals and amnesty schemes disguised in a foreign language. And make no mistake... If we don’t stop this now, this “DIGNITY Act” becomes the **launchpad for full citizenship** down the road. That’s where this leads. And once it happens—you can’t undo it. That’s why your voice matters right now more than ever. My friend, in case we haven’t met, my name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. You may have heard of AMAC Action before – we’re the #1 most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative seniors like you. If you’ve ever heard of AMAC Action, you may know that unlike the left-leaning AARP, we’ve been fighting AGAINST “Obamacare”, AGAINST “Medicare for All,” and AGAINST all of these radical schemes to “transform” America and our elections. That’s why we have dozens of local chapters and hundreds of delegates fighting to protect our elections, the rule of law, our constitution, and the Judeo-Christian values America was built on. **[And now we’re leading the fight to STOP AMNESTY.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ **Stop the Scheme!** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And my friend, your support right away is critical, because with razor-thin margins in Congress, just a handful of weak Republicans could make the difference. That means we need to crank up the **pressure.** It means **YOUR voice matters right now.** And that means **we must act immediately.** So please: **[Sign your EMERGENCY NO AMNESTY PETITION right away](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** And when you sign your petition, please make a one-time contribution to help us cover the cost to process your petition, expand our efforts, and flood Congress with opposition and STOP this bill before it gains momentum. A pressure campaign like the one we must build takes time, money, and resources. That’s why your support is so critical. Thank you for standing strong against this scheme!

**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_** **AMAC Action**

# [How Europe's Drug Pricing Policies Leave American Families Paying More For The Same Medicines](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1123743&post_id=198063604&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk4MDYzNjA0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzkxMTUxMTQsImV4cCI6MTc4MTcwNzExNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTExMjM3NDMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.CvyWtX03Gid7mwmo5XzU3SWlC8BlK80rIft4DLL1C8I)
### Europe benefits from U.S. innovation while Americans are hung out to dry

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b849bc-584a-4614-9aeb-3482874374b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When a middle-class woman in Ohio picks up her husband's heart medication at the pharmacy counter, the sticker shock hits hard: hundreds of dollars out of pocket, even with insurance. Yet the same drug, developed with American research dollars, sells for a fraction of that price across the Atlantic in countries like Germany or France.
This isn't an isolated frustration. Millions of American families face the same reality every month, paying dramatically higher prices for prescription drugs that people in Europe and other wealthy nations get at steep discounts.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Rv-W7mxNBWpcrtpYcwbS07ytb6w8sdut_fdixImrmps?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=198063604)
A major 2024 [study](https://substack.com/redirect/d6a32040-c82f-42a4-97af-a15d88c7c8c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the RAND Corporation put hard numbers on the gap. U.S. prescription drug prices overall run about 2.78 times higher than in 32 other developed countries tracked by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), an international forum of 38 member countries working to promote policies that improve global economic and social well-being.
For brand-name drugs, the newer, often life-saving ones, Americans pay more than three times as much, even after rebates and discounts.
Here's how it works in practice: European governments set strict price caps, use "reference pricing" that ties what they'll pay to the lowest price in neighboring countries, and negotiate tough deals with drug makers. Companies, needing to cover the massive costs of research and clinical trials, then charge far more in the freer U.S. market, where prices aren't tightly controlled. The result? Every day, Americans and U.S. taxpayers end up subsidizing the medicines the rest of the world uses on the cheap. President Trump has called this out for years. In May 2025, he [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/13a7b5fa-5a93-4726-a04e-d0a4d49a490a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the European Union of using "[brutal](https://substack.com/redirect/9addcb17-257a-4f2d-9e13-3c4554df2114?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" tactics to force low prices overseas, especially in places like Germany, driving up costs for patients back home. It's a complaint that resonates in kitchens and doctors' offices nationwide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65a018e4-617c-4a18-b030-6a65b45ed6d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7ef2d93-c8f3-4430-af7b-f02ff093b84d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The situation mirrors what Trump highlighted during his first term with NATO defense [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/13e5a820-9480-4fa7-b4e2-134874afbbfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). For years, many European allies contributed far less than their share while relying on American military strength. Pressure from Washington eventually pushed more countries to increase their budgets. The same principle, Trump and his team argue, should apply to pharmaceuticals: wealthier nations benefiting from U.S.-driven innovation should pay a fairer share.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Rv-W7mxNBWpcrtpYcwbS07ytb6w8sdut_fdixImrmps?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198063604)
A 2018 White House Council of Economic Advisers [report](https://substack.com/redirect/af9bf8ee-8fdf-4940-b4d6-ac91d98be5e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explained the mechanics clearly. Foreign governments act as giant single buyers, using their leverage to keep prices artificially low. That leaves American families, employers, insurers, and programs like Medicare shouldering a bigger portion of the global bill for developing new treatments.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe6e76e0-78dd-4a82-aeb2-41598d5552ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
One tool already on the books could help change this. Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 [allows](https://substack.com/redirect/5cac0c4e-d22a-4c43-b23f-037073d5a516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the U.S. to investigate and respond to foreign practices that unfairly burden American businesses and consumers. Europe's drug pricing system certainly fits that description.
The Trump administration has made clear it wants reciprocity, not confrontation for its own sake. The goal is straightforward: ensure that countries with strong economies pay prices that better reflect the value of cutting-edge medicines, just as they were pressed to contribute more for collective defense.
There are many reasons why this hits home for ordinary Americans:
* Most groundbreaking new drugs originate from research that is funded or incentivized by the U.S. market.
* When companies can't recover costs here, it affects which treatments reach the market next -- and what your family can afford. Continued imbalance risks slowing innovation over time, meaning fewer new options for cancer, Alzheimer's, diabetes, and other conditions that touch nearly every community. Drug pricing is undeniably [complex](https://substack.com/redirect/7ec13402-97ec-4cf5-961e-43e6d67966a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), involving insurance rebates, patents, and regulations.
* But the bottom line feels simple to many families struggling with medical bills: Americans shouldn't keep carrying the heaviest load for medicines our economy and scientists help create while the rest of the world gets them on the cheap.

As policymakers debate next steps, from trade negotiations to domestic reforms, the central question remains one of basic fairness. Should hardworking families in places like Ohio, Texas, and Pennsylvania continue subsidizing lower pharmaceutical prices for patients abroad, or is it time for wealthier allies to shoulder more of the cost?
For many Americans facing the sticker shock of their monthly pharmacy bill, the answer seems clear.

name: Steve Scalise
subject: It’s time for me to say sorry
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
You’re the heart and soul of the MAGA movement.
| I need to apologize to you.
I'm sorry, truly I am.
I'm sorry that some people accuse you of not being MAGA if you don't make a donation.
I'm sorry that some people lie to you about who they are to try to trick you into donating.
And I'm sorry that many folks don't even show their appreciation when you do donate.
It drives me crazy that people try to treat you like that, and it's important to hear why I do things differently.
First things first.
This is Majority Leader Steve Scalise.
Secondly, I want to thank you for all of the support you've given to the GOP over the years; it really means a lot.
But right now we're staring down some concerning numbers, and it has my team and I really worried.
The Democrats are currently unloading 100 million dollars into 35 GOP seats to obliterate our House Majority once and for all, and here is the truth: Right now, we simply don't have the funds to fully fund our campaign operations in all 35 races.
[So the simple truth is that I need your help before our House Majority is a thing of the past.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=ba1316e0aea64ea9b16375b0bdb452bf&_e=HMmsj_l7MlAtHTb2KMEkUCU5kMxBm1YytU0G8w0KgdnWSy29IfWw-ybL46y2NFlJhdbL01IBtoNboI3Sfr6JoZL1aANNm81YjqPpKZidGMdvU-iXfGV_PC27d9Kl7kNeR_qlqu0opmZuCObyXS7wkrpDs5PDpSYG45Qo4QYxCZ5B7z6tMGLv9oipox32fMt0HEpiQYH5sF8hEJV0nYxAfpVh4UWHOyhELoKoiCjPhFwlFohrW73c9Suzo6xi-TRhTJTmnow4yLhPCc5YLPlfAJ_pK3qIINOo1R1ONyYFMrmlRKugZMrUNPdTkedz8_pQ84HZGriwa_11no4JXTaDzHzNj4h9Wcfd0B1sp9uiJzOKmIUK7sfiTboPA6aeQMderQpM-kih73qajoep4OaImcVVtm4rmyvLn_qEcsR5H3hqY0XRHEIZe0Tr5gU5enip-Bh-gBJjCbh_basHyRseoKFhemMl6pwlrpQM4hJIHoa6mQ0TsgLcfLDwXbXgEN7ECbO-N5Cuj-u8rza8PJtOKYduDRZ98xNQKr14zjduLiAyDK5Ex6Sg2dySP4Vo4lEKlrbFlWRdzvkDfjqLXzEPp_63OHNdyYl8rn4QRPw0Bcx13qhAsGMw6GzPUHC8KCCPXeICFFMo5ljv-X-98YZwNKywHkH2wbFf7J2Dy2uyBbgn4vXc9PaRPR4f-NNaU8w99Y1aEVxpxQRV2qV9fxmQJQ%3D%3D)
If you can't afford to help right now, no problem. I won't hold that against you. Taking care of your loved ones always comes first. I will never question your Party loyalty or shame you for not making a donation.

Peter, I wanted to take some time today to share some of my favorite headlines this month:

**_9ABC_ : New Iowa law expands protections for domestic abuse victims**

Thanks to bipartisan efforts in the Iowa State House, a bill was just signed into law that will make it easier for survivors of domestic abuse to submit protective orders by allowing law enforcement to file emergency protective orders after hours and on the weekends.

**_The New York Times_ : In a Milestone for A.L.S., a Treatment Helps Some Patients Improve**

In April 2023, the FDA granted accelerated approval for Toferson, a breakthrough drug treatment for a specific type of A.L.S. Now, participants in a long-term study are reporting amazing improvements, and researchers are exploring the possibility of reversing the disease.

**_Iowa Now_ : A new way to capture water — from air and with sunlight**

Thanks to funding from the U.S. National Science Foundation, chemists at the University of Iowa just unveiled a lattice that captures water from the air and stores it. This concept shows promise as a method for providing drinking water to people and areas with limited access. Go Hawkeyes!

I know good news is a little hard to come by these days. But these headlines really are a great reminder that when positive innovation and policy are prioritized, amazing things happen. I really do believe the government has a role in doing good for our communities – it just takes the right kind of leadership to do that.

But that's just not what we're seeing from Mariannette Miller-Meeks. She and her colleagues have pushed for cuts to the HHS, slashed funding for health science research, and she's continually voted to roll back environmental protections.

clean_body: | = Peter, I wanted to take some time today to share some of my favorite headlines this month: 9ABC : New Iowa law expands protections for domestic abuse victims Thanks to bipartisan efforts in the Iowa State House, a bill was just signed into law that will make it easier for survivors of domestic abuse to submit protective orders by allowing law enforcement to file emergency protective orders after hours and on the weekends. The New York Times : In a Milestone for A.L.S., a Treatment Helps Some Patients Improve In April 2023, the FDA granted accelerated approval for Toferson, a breakthrough drug treatment for a specific type of A.L.S. Now, participants in a long-term study are reporting amazing improvements, and researchers are exploring the possibility of reversing the disease. Iowa Now : A new way to capture water — from air and with sunlight Thanks to funding from the U.S. National Science Foundation, chemists at the University of Iowa just unveiled a lattice that captures water from the air and stores it. This concept shows promise as a method for providing drinking water to people and areas with limited access. Go Hawkeyes! I know good news is a little hard to come by these days. But these headlines really are a great reminder that when positive innovation and policy are prioritized, amazing things happen. I really do believe the government has a role in doing good for our communities – it just takes the right kind of leadership to do that. But that's just not what we're seeing from Mariannette Miller-Meeks. She and her colleagues have pushed for cuts to the HHS, slashed funding for health science research, and she's continually voted to roll back environmental protections. I'm Stepping into the Arena to Debate It Live.
The idea is no longer whispered in obscure corners -- it's gaining traction in pockets of the right: strip women of the ballot and America will magically heal. I don't dismiss it. I confront it. That's why I'm facing Rachel Wilson head-to-head this **Wednesday, May 20th at 7pm ET** in a live, respectful, and no-holds-barred debate:
"Should Women Be Allowed to Vote?"
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRoeWJhcm5ldHRlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.xzCF8MgQbrA9FVkUEOytTgPGWJ4UjZULArBPh0xZRtY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=198207835)
We've watched "fringe" ideas quietly take over our schools, our laws, our institutions, and our borders because too many of us stayed silent, assuming they'd remain fringe. I'm not making that mistake again. Whether you agree with me or not, this is the marketplace of ideas in action. Bring your strongest arguments. I'll bring mine.
Watch LIVE

After the debate -- join me exclusively on Substack for the extended post-game analysis, audience Q&A, and my unfiltered thoughts.
Mark your calendar. Tune in. Comment. Share this far and wide.
The conversation is happening with or without us. I choose to show up.
See you Wednesday,

My wife and I both grew up around abuse, addiction, and crime. We know what it means to fight your way out and build your way up with nothing but grit and the stubborn belief that things can be different. I built a career from nothing in the music industry, eventually working on Grammy-nominated albums and sold-out world tours. I've been building my life in this community for 25 years. I'm a husband, a father of two boys, and a public servant who knows exactly what it means when bad leadership pushes working families to the sidelines... **because I 've lived it.**
**[Before introducing my new opponent, it would mean the world if you could help us hit our weekly goal HERE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/80b2bb86-51ca-4018-8869-9f2c2346c3fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!**

## **Now meet Scott DesJarlais.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/85f58a5d-8442-4879-8373-c0f480deba24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He's been in Washington for 14 years. A doctor-turned-career-politician who campaigns on family values while court documents tell a very different story. He's missed nearly 5% of his votes (more than double the average) and when he did show up on January 6th, he voted to throw out yours. He's collected endorsements, ratings, and a taxpayer-funded salary for over a decade. _What has the 4th District gotten in return?_
One of us knows what it costs to build something from nothing. The other knows what it costs to keep a seat in Washington.
One of us grew up around the consequences of other people's bad decisions and carries that every single day. The other made plenty of bad decisions of his own and faced none of the consequences.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6db57e22-e13a-4488-8531-269e1f44705c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
One of us is running for Congress because this district deserves real representation. The other is running because Washington is the only place left that will have him.
Tennessee's 4th District doesn't need another politician who learned how to survive in Washington. It needs someone who already knows how to survive and fight in the real world.

Peter, For 15 years, Californians have given Democrats total control of our state. What have Democrats done with that trust? **They 've "lost" over $150 BILLION just to fraud.** And they've wasted OUR money on:
* Healthcare for illegal immigrants, while our veterans can't get care.
* "Ending homelessness", while NGOs get rich and over 161,000 people sleep on the streets every night, by the state's official count.
* A high-speed rail project that has built ZERO miles of track.

It's time to end this madness. If Californians want different results, we MUST elect leaders who will:
* ARREST the crooks who are bankrupting our state.
* Clear the streets of addicts and the mentally ill, and mandate treatment.

# **Fraudster convicted in $250M Minnesota COVID meal scam claims Rep. Ilhan Omar knew what was going on**
Aimee Bock, founder of nonprofit Feeding Our Future convicted in March 2025 of fraud charges for helping restaurant owners file fake claims stealing child nutrition funds, **[told The NY Post](https://substack.com/redirect/67b15098-6deb-4b94-996f-eba348bdedd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from jail that "I struggle to believe that (Rep. Ilhan Omar) wouldn't have known" about the scheme.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67b15098-6deb-4b94-996f-eba348bdedd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Omar 's enablement -** Omar introduced the MEALS Act in March 2020 allowing USDA to waive school-meal requirements and eliminate site inspections, with Bock alleging Omar personally intervened whenever waivers expired to keep fraud continuing. Omar's name appeared six times in court exhibits from Bock's trial regarding waiver assistance requests.
* **Omar filmed promo at Safari restaurant, biggest fraudster with $16M conviction** : Omar recorded a May 2020 video at Safari restaurant claiming it "provides 2,300 meals to children and their families" daily and held her 2018 election night party there, while co-owner Salim Said was later convicted of defrauding the government of $16 million--the scheme's highest individual sum--and awaits sentencing. Bock said "A lot of the sites were working directly with her, being that a lot of the operators were from the same Somali community."

Last week I wrote about the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling in Louisiana v. Callais and the special session Governor Tate Reeves had called for May 20. Since then, the federal appeals court vacated the order that required Mississippi to redraw, and this week the Governor called the session off.
So what now?
The lawsuit isn't over. The case is back before Judge Sharion Aycock, who has given both sides 14 days to file on next steps. The plaintiffs have agreed they will not push for new judicial elections in 2026 -- that commitment is what let the Governor to cancel. But Aycock will still have to rule again, now under the tougher Callais standard.
The bigger story is what the Governor did NOT do. Many in his own party wanted him to expand the call to include congressional redistricting -- in plain English, take a run at redrawing Bennie Thompson's 2nd Congressional District. Reeves did not. He pointed out that when Mississippi was forced to redraw state legislative districts in 2025, Republicans actually LOST their state Senate supermajority. Redistricting is not always the political win conservatives assume. But Reeves was clear about the longer fight, saying "the tenure of Congressman Bennie Thompson's reign of terror over the 2nd Congressional District is over." He expects the Legislature to redraw congressional, state legislative, and state Supreme Court districts before the 2027 state elections.
Here is where I want to be honest with my fellow conservatives. Mississippi's current districts -- judicial, legislative, and congressional -- were drawn largely on race. They were drawn that way to comply with the Voting Rights Act as the courts interpreted it before Callais. A Republican state senator admitted on television last week that Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District was drawn the way it is specifically to protect Bennie Thompson. That admission applies to more than just MS-2.
If we are serious that maps should not be drawn around race, the honest conclusion is that Mississippi's maps should be redrawn. Not to defeat any one congressman. Not to grow the Republican margin. Redrawn on an honestly neutral basis -- following county lines, communities of interest, population and geography -- the same way we would draw them if we did not know in advance which party benefited.
The dilemma is whether we can actually do that. Will the Legislature commit, before the first line is drawn, to a process that is principled even when the outcome is uncertain? That is the question conservatives ought to be asking now, while there is no court order forcing anyone's hand. Callais gave us the legal room to draw cleaner maps. It did not give us a moral free pass to draw them around politics instead.
One thing worth saying: the lawsuit that started all of this is about judicial districts, not congressional ones. The justices who decide cases that affect Mississippians every day are elected from districts that haven't changed since 1987. I have not seen a single Facebook or X post about it. We argue about Bennie Thompson because he is on television. We rarely argue about who sits on our Supreme Court -- even though it probably matters to Mississippians more than who sits in Congress.
The worry has lifted for now. No special session. No court order. Districts unchanged. But this is a pause, not an ending. The fight will be back in 2027.
This isn't going away. Whatever happens next, conservatives have a choice to make. We can stick to the principles we've argued for years, or we can set them aside when it's convenient. I'd rather we stick to them. That means making sure every Mississippian, no matter where they live or how they vote, has a real voice in choosing who represents them.

subject: Julia Letlow's Dominant Primary Victory and Path to Runoff Victory
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
| | |

| | | | | |
## **MEMORANDUM**
**TO:** Interested Parties **FROM:** Parker Carey, Campaign Manager — Letlow for Louisiana **DATE:** May 18, 2026 **RE:** Julia Letlow's Dominant Primary Victory and Path to Runoff Victory
* * *
### **Overview**
Julia Letlow delivered a dominant first-place victory in Louisiana's Republican Senate primary, coming within five points of winning outright despite over $14 million being spent against her.
According to official parish-level results from the Louisiana Secretary of State, Letlow received 179,876 votes — **45%** of the statewide Republican primary vote. She finished **nearly 17 points ahead of John Fleming** and **more than 20 points ahead of Bill Cassidy** , who was eliminated despite his incumbency and the millions spent by his campaign and allies.
The result is a clear testament to President Trump's complete and total endorsement, Julia's conservative record, and the strength of the America First movement in Louisiana. Republican voters rejected the attacks, ignored the noise, and rallied behind President Trump's endorsed conservative.
* * *
### **Julia's Victory Was Broad and Statewide**
Julia's first-place finish was a dominant statewide performance against two statewide elected officials.
* **She carried 52 of Louisiana's 64 parishes**
* **She carried all six Congressional districts**
* **She won 22 parishes with an outright majority**
* **She won 16 of the 20 highest-turnout parishes**
* **She carried six of Louisiana's seven media markets**

By comparison: Fleming won 9 parishes, all clustered in his Shreveport-area home base. Cassidy, the sitting U.S. Senator, won just 3 parishes in the entire state.
**Performance across the state's key regions:****North Louisiana / Monroe DMA — Letlow 62.5%.** Julia hit 62% in her home media market — a 36-point margin over Fleming. She won Ouachita Parish (population center of northeast Louisiana) by 38.8 points with over 14,000 votes cast. She broke 65% in seven parishes: Tensas (74.6%), Concordia (69.8%), East Carroll (69.2%), Morehouse (67.3%), Madison (67.1%), Catahoula (65.4%), and Richland (64.3%).
**Acadiana — Letlow 46.7%, +13.6 over Fleming.** Julia won every major parish in the region: Lafayette, Acadia, Iberia, St. Landry, St. Martin, Vermilion, and Evangeline.
**Southwest Louisiana — Letlow 46.9%, +17.5 over Fleming.** Julia carried the Lake Charles market by 17 points, winning Calcasieu by 22.8 points with over 16,000 votes cast.
**Baton Rouge region — Letlow 40.9%, +12.3 over Cassidy.** Julia carried 8 of 9 parishes in the Baton Rouge media market — Ascension, Livingston, East Feliciana, West Feliciana, Pointe Coupee, St. Helena, Iberville, and West Baton Rouge. The lone exception was East Baton Rouge Parish itself, where Cassidy edged her by **185 votes** — a near-tie in his home parish.
**New Orleans region — Letlow 42.4%, +7.4 over Cassidy.** In the state's largest GOP primary market (34% of all Republican votes statewide), Julia beat a sitting U.S. Senator by more than 10,000 votes. Cassidy's vote was concentrated in Orleans and Jefferson, but Julia carried St. Tammany — the largest single parish in the metro — and remained dominant across the broader region.

* * *
### **Fleming's Support Is Geographically Trapped**

### **All 9 parishes Fleming won are in or adjacent to the Shreveport DMA** — Bossier, Webster, De Soto, Sabine, Bienville, Claiborne, Red River, Vernon, and Grant (which he won by exactly one vote, 1,189 to 1,188). These are the parishes of his old congressional district.

### **Julia carried Caddo Parish, the largest population center in Fleming's old congressional district, 6,317 to 5,838.**

### **Fleming won zero parishes in the New Orleans DMA. Zero in the Baton Rouge DMA. Zero in Lafayette. Zero in Lake Charles. Zero in Monroe. Zero in CD-5.**

### To win a statewide runoff, Fleming would have to hold every voter he already has, consolidate an overwhelming share of Cassidy's voters, and dramatically expand into the same parishes and media markets where Julia already beat him decisively. There is no historical precedent for that kind of geographic inversion in a six-week runoff window.

* * *
### **The Runoff Math Strongly Favors Julia**
Julia begins the runoff less than 6 points from a majority. Fleming begins more than 21 points away.
Assuming the same total vote universe:
* **Julia needs roughly 20,684 additional votes to cross 50%.**
* **Fleming would need roughly 87,132 additional votes to reach the same threshold.**

Put another way: Julia only needs to consolidate a modest share of the eliminated vote. Fleming would need an overwhelming — and unrealistic — share of Cassidy and Spencer voters just to catch up.
That math is even harder for Fleming when you account for who Cassidy's voters actually are. Cassidy's coalition was suburban, college-educated, traditional Republicans concentrated in Jefferson, East Baton Rouge, and Orleans. In each of those parishes except Orleans, **Julia finished a close second to Cassidy. Fleming was a distant third.** Cassidy's voters in his strongholds are already overwhelmingly more familiar with Julia as their second choice than with Fleming.
That is the fundamental reality of the runoff: Julia starts with a massive vote advantage, a broad statewide coalition, President Trump's endorsement, and a clear path to victory.
* * *
**The Outside Spending Onslaught Is Over** The nearly $14 million spent against Julia in the primary was driven overwhelmingly by Bill Cassidy and his allied super PAC, the Louisiana Freedom Fund — built to protect a sitting incumbent who is no longer on the ballot. With Cassidy eliminated, that spending apparatus has no candidate to defend and no remaining reason to spend.
John Fleming has no comparable outside group, no national donor base, and a campaign that raised just $45,000 in real money in the final quarter before the primary. For the first time in this race, Julia will run without millions of dollars in attack ads being fired at her every week. The runoff will be decided on the candidates and their records, and that is a fight Julia wins every time.
* * *
### **Conclusion**
Julia Letlow won a dominant first-place victory despite nearly $14 million being spent against her.
She won 45% of the vote. She carried 52 of 64 parishes. She won 6 of 7 media markets. She won 16 of the 20 highest-turnout parishes. She defeated an incumbent United States Senator by more than 80,000 votes. She entered the runoff with a 66,448-vote lead over John Fleming.
Louisiana Republicans made their choice clear. They want President Trump's endorsed conservative in the United States Senate, and **Julia Letlow is in a commanding position to finish the job on June 27th.**
