name: James Talarico
subject: We are pacing behind
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Talarico for Texas
body:
#
Peter —
We’re around the halfway point for our first fundraising quarter of the general election. I know we’ve asked a lot of you since winning the primary just over two months ago — but I want to explain why your support right now is so important.
Next week, we’ll know if we’re facing John Cornyn or Ken Paxton. The money is going to come pouring in no matter who wins. Republican mega-donors just told _The New York Times_ they’re sitting on the sidelines waiting to give massive sums to the Republican nominee, and right-wing super PACs are sitting on war chests of hundreds of millions of dollars they can flood into Texas at a moment’s notice.
So we need to prove that our people-powered movement can go toe-to-toe with all this Big Money. That makes next month’s FEC deadline a major test. We will have to report our fundraising numbers publicly again. We’ll have to do it if they are good, and we’ll have to do it if they are not.
The truth is that all eyes will be on these numbers. Our opponents and the media are asking if the energy behind our campaign after the primary was a fluke or if we’re building a movement that really can take back Texas.
Things have been slow so far this quarter. Truthfully, we are pacing behind where I hoped we would be. So now is the time for us to put our foot on the gas. We need to go into the final half of the quarter in an even stronger position.
We’ve set an ambitious goal before we hit the halfway point of the quarter: 15,000 donations in 48 hours. This is what it will take to keep us on track to reach our targets and continue laying the foundation to win this race.
**[I’m personally asking you to contribute $5 or whatever you can spare today. Given the size of Texas, this could easily be the most expensive race of 2026. Peter,
The St. Louis City Board of Public Service recently unanimously approved a conditional use permit for yet another new data center at the old Famous-Barr warehouse property.
Let me be clear about what’s happening here.
We are told these projects are “ urgent .” We’re told they bring “ jobs ” and “ progress .”
And after things go wrong, we’re told that “ no one could have known the consequences ”—just like with Coldwater Creek, just like with the Westlake Landfill, just like during COVID when masks weren’t properly mandated, where communities are left to deal with the fallout long after decisions are made without them.
It’s always the same pattern: decisions get made quickly, communities get told too late, and then it’s us, the people who live here, who are left to deal with what they got wrong.
We’re not accepting that anymore.
We’re saying no to data centers being rushed into our neighborhoods without the proper study, investment, or safeguards. This is too much, too fast, and they’re giving us too little.
The health of St. Louis residents must come first when outside developers come into our city. We cannot keep repeating a cycle where our neighborhoods are treated like experiment zones for corporate profit.
As I’ve said before: I will always stand with people over profit.
St. Louis has already suffered for decades from projects forced onto our communities without our consent. This time, our leaders must listen. They must protect our families before any developer’s timeline.
Because once these decisions are made, it’s our communities that have to live with them.
You with me? We need to organize, push back, and make it clear that this cannot go unanswered. Will you stand with us right now and help power this fight so I can protect our neighborhoods from office, before it’s too late? clean_body: [] Peter, The St. Louis City Board of Public Service recently unanimously approved a conditional use permit for yet another new data center at the old Famous-Barr warehouse property. Let me be clear about what’s happening here. We are told these projects are “ urgent .” We’re told they bring “ jobs ” and “ progress .” And after things go wrong, we’re told that “ no one could have known the consequences ”—just like with Coldwater Creek, just like with the Westlake Landfill, just like during COVID when masks weren’t properly mandated, where communities are left to deal with the fallout long after decisions are made without them. It’s always the same pattern: decisions get made quickly, communities get told too late, and then it’s us, the people who live here, who are left to deal with what they got wrong. We’re not accepting that anymore. We’re saying no to data centers being rushed into our neighborhoods without the proper study, investment, or safeguards. This is too much, too fast, and they’re giving us too little. The health of St. Louis residents must come first when outside developers come into our city. We cannot keep repeating a cycle where our neighborhoods are treated like experiment zones for corporate profit. As I’ve said before: I will always stand with people over profit. St. Louis has already suffered for decades from projects forced onto our communities without our consent. This time, our leaders must listen. They must protect our families before any developer’s timeline. Because once these decisions are made, it’s our communities that have to live with them. You with me? We need to organize, push back, and make it clear that this cannot go unanswered. Will you stand with us right now and help power this fight so I can protect our neighborhoods from office, before it’s too late? The predators are closer than most parents realize
The men arrested included a teacher, a cruise ship worker... and even a Santa Claus

| | | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c9c0ebe60a8b452cb4d5b4d96f4c1147&_e=U4o0BE0wKyOcTx_DV8HpvPRNk5VMAMhPuupFVujlDTLhylP1-UEC1yCDoa4Uakom2Le17JuCK5lfNiouJG1St4xmpB2UPioRkqL8VnxP30ZC54UN-2-CDicmmA7XzGkRzYbVy2m_9HnUUrKUVW7w3WXC8LTTgrXmfdXjmM2EmSKTjjeyPuU5QfOVm33WX4zS61jM6u0yO1NDMvUBZOyG_Bt1kpMS-_TNzBxpZHi1lTpEfVAhAS_Yqj9IswjK1KC8himIObzwvGz-he9lSZtsCfmo7IJjhCJ8f6Dfs0D_PeMmdAPPckJHA0vHK-U8hNnn-TidozUKUWgpY7wswSMhCCIKsQeOfgNVt0lmkO92xf7_U3Y09NN_OR8MGRuVBwr88KN7i1oxuoRAH-Obm1kES8ZYKu8x-lcYOmbm-DAGiOTOuiZ1FBCWaDkdssaz5zUA2clW4ur66wSiqi_on3mIY4Sn7FIHwB6uiJ49Hh85CwAEg-Hb5Ux3CF6j4dr4Ut5FGOTM6fkt9RYTY-7-IE4hSvHXnPYzh0mVSNWtp3wJSW35Oha_ApUcgsL0oh8BqPV8b3TMJzJ-RCoZEUBUSGIfC5sE2ZE6Ud9A56I5IQIdzXH8m4W4fPIcZZNRxomf3T0supH8iRfgi3y8Nm27L3mii596D687YvYytIW4_VsYDMVXGdxFHqKloD9OE4bzTkbFyglQbzcb4lNsb-J6kqCiHg%3D%3D)

| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
Most people think child traffickers look evil. They don't. Sometimes they look like a teacher. Sometimes they look like a cruise ship worker smiling at families on vacation. Sometimes they even dress like Santa Claus. That is the terrifying truth America is waking up to. And sadly, the news today reminds us why this mission matters so much.
---
* **Disney cruise ship staffers among 28 arrested in massive child pornography operation.**

* **Well-known Santa Claus among 19 arrested in child predator sting.**

* **High School math teacher among 89 arrested in human trafficking operation. **

---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c9c0ebe60a8b452cb4d5b4d96f4c1147&_e=U4o0BE0wKyOcTx_DV8HpvPRNk5VMAMhPuupFVujlDTLhylP1-UEC1yCDoa4Uakom2Le17JuCK5lfNiouJG1St4xmpB2UPioRkqL8VnxP30ZC54UN-2-CDicmmA7XzGkRzYbVy2m_9HnUUrKUVW7w3WXC8LTTgrXmfdXjmM2EmSKTjjeyPuU5QfOVm33WX4zS61jM6u0yO1NDMvUBZOyG_Bt1kpMS-_TNzBxpZHi1lTpEfVAhAS_Yqj9IswjK1KC8l9y4_ZvorH3zlH3I8U_QTkLyzyD8nommT1GCnzBPKFWTUPq2vVxcwBHwSmh6qRrTwCtxtI9oce5450s0JukC5fXbJA4ncugaoyki8fpQ_P5FEbzxAeoCIN5syHuyNY3vTu9-fYRIhmR_7G4mxbwDl0IUR4_Y6EwNYayKhTPVuALRQ8Kv_l784RXpk6GnUEmU9eLdI1wx-NlTaG29nL58DaKHydzzy_bA-M_4S7mVMtuAJrAlFHiweV0UI7bZG3KOxEuDrEMqo0hO8PDRN_XwM-1i8Wtze1PcGurFLbETX2m9yhAQsYGUdnIi7TeiOWaevcG8Pf66_gTf6IOa0Mn3GJ6UXYyRCOZa7PtfmX4P823WqMdxHzKWTb7B26XXemeSusULpe8Jv_iEbyuOyxeK26H9fUiWuUhM-cVDkNntLt0NWpHJ7zY8a3eLTGRAmmNaWOvajbysbR8sCgADSlwdog%3D%3D)
---
Three different stories.
Three different places. But all convey one chilling truth ties them all together: **The people who prey on children are hiding in plain sight.**
---
[ Stand Against Child Trafficking](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c9c0ebe60a8b452cb4d5b4d96f4c1147&_e=U4o0BE0wKyOcTx_DV8HpvPRNk5VMAMhPuupFVujlDTLhylP1-UEC1yCDoa4Uakom2Le17JuCK5lfNiouJG1St4xmpB2UPioRkqL8VnxP30ZC54UN-2-CDicmmA7XzGkRzYbVy2m_9HnUUrKUVW7w3WXC8LTTgrXmfdXjmM2EmSKTjjeyPuU5QfOVm33WX4zS61jM6u0yO1NDMvUBZOyG_Bt1kpMS-_TNzBxpZHi1lTpEfVAhAS_Yqj9IswjK1KC86tdNbyApe6rwi1dkJQmV71nXbMNsrPBCiK5g22NcV3TyvH4vvdUk--wSWZYtbv6l5HrvFyEqibbnxRTkFNfy14fRgPZYLvqj50jBl_HmDUz9pAk1lfoFc_OeVqFBu4AZM56cDt7VA-pG5zT3k68BDkHDa7HHfl9Y8Nky6Ekr_gz3NZ8RN60eFqVCfg5dJFa6VVA_32as_zAHok8_GmY_SUYWBK7f_x0yXzZLCfXQ9DGmP1NGMtxCo73fN6eiWR49y_NncDxU19kDYxgB5HYvuwSI50k-72gEpPVAuS4kqU_Y-f-lQFew0o-GFL660-pB7n_fzi58bHwkkzw4bpEIY6XPqaSfeJ6rWmj9FWzq1HDadrFCtCu1DvZVd70QqWMLS1AJj1_SwUQmmkXWAvGVqA8Nd5FQ3NcI73MImAaoDHob3WvgNeA7FeHHPBycSR7-qDnEjVYK-HaYIR36sy5jug%3D%3D)
---
My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of Sound of Freedom and founder of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** Years ago, after hearing firsthand stories about trafficked children, my life changed forever. What I learned broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold like products. And most people had no idea this darkness existed. Thart's why I helped create the Sound of Freedom film. Not for fame. Not for Hollywood. **But because I believed people needed to see the truth. ** Many people told us the movie would fail. Studios rejected it. Doors closed.
**But I could not stay silent.** **When innocent children are suffering, silence becomes part of the problem. **

Recently, while accepting the Catholic Champion Award, I shared the promise that still guides my life today: **" I made a promise to God, to dedicate my life to ending child trafficking because God's children are not for sale." **That promise became the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Today, we are working to protect vulnerable children through prevention, rescue support, education, awareness, and advocacy.
---
* We help strengthen struggling families before traffickers can target their children.

* We equip trusted partners working to rescue exploited children.

* We educate parents and communities about warning signs predators use to groom and manipulate children.

* We advocate for stronger laws to protect innocent lives.

---
Jesus said: _" Let the little children come to me... for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." _(Matthew 19:14) **Every child is created by God with dignity.** **Every child deserves safety.**
---
[ Stand Against Child Trafficking](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c9c0ebe60a8b452cb4d5b4d96f4c1147&_e=U4o0BE0wKyOcTx_DV8HpvPRNk5VMAMhPuupFVujlDTLhylP1-UEC1yCDoa4Uakom2Le17JuCK5lfNiouJG1St4xmpB2UPioRkqL8VnxP30ZC54UN-2-CDicmmA7XzGkRzYbVy2m_9HnUUrKUVW7w3WXC8LTTgrXmfdXjmM2EmSKTjjeyPuU5QfOVm33WX4zS61jM6u0yO1NDMvUBZOyG_Bt1kpMS-_TNzBxpZHi1lTpEfVAhAS_Yqj9IswjK1KC8rvBFNnh6EyP4CM_guBNuckiYpdyJFu9NK2aUxxCOlxI4cF-sot4Pu03mVUBlLIgXmHWxsqSnGXK1AJUaM2L0V0PkyTC3DYrZUEfX_lsH61vkwZbVzPong7rIyxwFSfVxcxbuN7mcu-Z3nTh7D3H-hMoOk9sy8UIa4OAxvh1neqXFGFS2CHttRULhfUgxJZg8Trx6wD0lTAXY_r79xlrPERm-04fz9V0Qn8IInNI_TnVIw_7UXC-bT2-moiJWKH9-eEyo8OXx8kwGuAeQAe5gyVcctCRBrGES9Z3eQ52UDBvHIfczelw4ERGyf_00CC_7Cj2Q2xgTNg5gJi_1X8hP1m5WDhe_eofpcG3Vzceyl2bzrCHMHnvuu04AOb5xqityOETxYqgAyKzDNDzhF0EHDlpf8vNygcjorG9GdcBadLfRBPf1IvDUA-iARsvORBdYYcR47FgYN99_4RUNStDiJg%3D%3D)

clean_body: The predators are closer than most parents realize The men arrested included a teacher, a cruise ship worker... and even a Santa Claus | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend, Most people think child traffickers look evil. They don't. Sometimes they look like a teacher. Sometimes they look like a cruise ship worker smiling at families on vacation. Sometimes they even dress like Santa Claus. That is the terrifying truth America is waking up to. And sadly, the news today reminds us why this mission matters so much. Disney cruise ship staffers among 28 arrested in massive child pornography operation. Well-known Santa Claus among 19 arrested in child predator sting. High School math teacher among 89 arrested in human trafficking operation. Three different stories. Three different places. But all convey one chilling truth ties them all together: The people who prey on children are hiding in plain sight. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Years ago, after hearing firsthand stories about trafficked children, my life changed forever. What I learned broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold like products. And most people had no idea this darkness existed. Thart's why I helped create the Sound of Freedom film. Not for fame. Not for Hollywood. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. Many people told us the movie would fail. Studios rejected it. Doors closed. But I could not stay silent. When innocent children are suffering, silence becomes part of the problem. Recently, while accepting the Catholic Champion Award, I shared the promise that still guides my life today: " I made a promise to God, to dedicate my life to ending child trafficking because God's children are not for sale." That promise became the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Today, we are working to protect vulnerable children through prevention, rescue support, education, awareness, and advocacy. We help strengthen struggling families before traffickers can target their children. We equip trusted partners working to rescue exploited children. We educate parents and communities about warning signs predators use to groom and manipulate children. We advocate for stronger laws to protect innocent lives. Jesus said: " Let the little children come to me... for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is created by God with dignity. Every child deserves safety. And every one of us has a choice: Look away or stand up and protect them. That's why I am reaching out to you today. Friend, will you make your first gift to help stop the sale of God's children? predators are hiding in plain sight. But together, we can shine light into the darkness. And together, we can tell the world: God 's Children are Not For Sale.** For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

body:
Louisiana is ground zero for stopping MAGA. That’s why I am asking for your help right now to fight this: we need every Democrat in the nation to rally to this fight.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xkj_jx6yInDYr4RNBsiUD9Frf_YQq5pMGWknKjvxXjCVRcVO2HnoQCPPSaNcQBoVMgsB5yz4WXW591rNlxFM8y-D7WGajAlj5ytjcKjWjLl-s0kBgA-xI6oenzccKFMLzAY9bKk1uNoRN1C38JkQMQtTIiE9bf3ClqHtXagHDFaIt8BYce4A-y-K6nXAuY-LfqG0KZj5AfEFFbm28ODwWA==&c=klWWvTk6SmXdaEqXlhv9vsqMzT8AVDFMrwH3nBgTCmgMV_5loHlSRA==&ch=ho0kvAVGX_5p6Z3tVMIn2nkzU_eXx3HqORoYC1-896FXd73Bbc0ZoA==)

| Peter,
Saturday was an election day in Louisiana.
Before polls even opened, more than 45,000 voters had learned that their votes were going to be thrown out.
And then when hundreds of thousands more went to the polls, they were told their votes would not count. That some elections (but not all) had been cancelled. That over halfway through the election year and just days before Election Day, our districts would be redrawn yet again.
If that sounds like a nightmare, it is. And while today the chaos and disenfranchisement is happening to Louisiana tomorrow it could be any voter in any red state--or if Trump achieves his ultimate ambition, this could happen to any voter anywhere at any time.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xkj_jx6yInDYr4RNBsiUD9Frf_YQq5pMGWknKjvxXjCVRcVO2HnoQCPPSaNcQBoVMgsB5yz4WXW591rNlxFM8y-D7WGajAlj5ytjcKjWjLl-s0kBgA-xI6oenzccKFMLzAY9bKk1uNoRN1C38JkQMQtTIiE9bf3ClqHtXagHDFaIt8BYce4A-y-K6nXAuY-LfqG0KZj5AfEy81CoO8z_PA==&c=klWWvTk6SmXdaEqXlhv9vsqMzT8AVDFMrwH3nBgTCmgMV_5loHlSRA==&ch=ho0kvAVGX_5p6Z3tVMIn2nkzU_eXx3HqORoYC1-896FXd73Bbc0ZoA==)
---

Voters across the country are upset and they are showing up even in once safe red districts to vote against MAGA.
Earlier this spring, Democratic voters propelled a Democrat to a landslide win in a Trump +13 Louisiana state house special election. And despite their attempts to take away our votes on Saturday, Dem turnout was through the roof approaching 2024 presidential election levels in a May primary.
My name is Cleo Fields. I am the Democratic Congressman for Louisiana's 6th District, which MAGA is rapidly moving to eliminate and redraw much redder.
But no matter what comes, I am going to stand and fight. Because this isn't about Republican versus Democrat. It's about right versus wrong, fairness versus fraud. It's about who we are as Americans and whether that means anything at all.
[I refuse to give up on the dreams that have given us all hope: that we can make progress and form a more perfect union together. I am running for something bigger than myself, and I need your support to win this race and show the world that despite Donald Trump's best efforts, freedom is alive and well in America:](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Xkj_jx6yInDYr4RNBsiUD9Frf_YQq5pMGWknKjvxXjCVRcVO2HnoQCPPSaNcQBoVXBngJ6hedKga2jn57xmUjK-j1xoEvfAFEEfR4WWvm0N1PoqxVVZMDBYDJDJmWZdV0MINRTMEpuuv1Ybq_1u_1D3aVEgXOgCcI3u1DdF3oi_a_WWXp_IOhthQSy4MOcw83SHub4nL-ykMr70ErylSRQkF97_-i-b1&c=klWWvTk6SmXdaEqXlhv9vsqMzT8AVDFMrwH3nBgTCmgMV_5loHlSRA==&ch=ho0kvAVGX_5p6Z3tVMIn2nkzU_eXx3HqORoYC1-896FXd73Bbc0ZoA==)

clean_body: Louisiana is ground zero for stopping MAGA. That’s why I am asking for your help right now to fight this: we need every Democrat in the nation to rally to this fight. | | | | | == | Peter, Saturday was an election day in Louisiana. Before polls even opened, more than 45,000 voters had learned that their votes were going to be thrown out. And then when hundreds of thousands more went to the polls, they were told their votes would not count. That some elections (but not all) had been cancelled. That over halfway through the election year and just days before Election Day, our districts would be redrawn yet again. If that sounds like a nightmare, it is. And while today the chaos and disenfranchisement is happening to Louisiana tomorrow it could be any voter in any red state--or if Trump achieves his ultimate ambition, this could happen to any voter anywhere at any time. | == Voters across the country are upset and they are showing up even in once safe red districts to vote against MAGA. Earlier this spring, Democratic voters propelled a Democrat to a landslide win in a Trump +13 Louisiana state house special election. And despite their attempts to take away our votes on Saturday, Dem turnout was through the roof approaching 2024 presidential election levels in a May primary. My name is Cleo Fields. I am the Democratic Congressman for Louisiana's 6th District, which MAGA is rapidly moving to eliminate and redraw much redder. But no matter what comes, I am going to stand and fight. Because this isn't about Republican versus Democrat. It's about right versus wrong, fairness versus fraud. It's about who we are as Americans and whether that means anything at all. == If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | == | == | | | == | == | == | == | Thank you. name: Jasmine Clark
subject: Public service is about trust

Peter, it's Pete Buttigieg.
Public service, at its core, is an exchange of trust. The people you serve extend their trust, and you hold it carefully – because you understand that trust, once broken, is genuinely hard to rebuild. I've spent a lot of time thinking about that compact, and about what it looks like when leaders take it seriously versus when they don't.
Dr. Jasmine Clark takes it seriously.
She's a scientist and an educator running for Congress in Georgia's 13th District, not because it's easy or because the political moment is particularly inviting, but because she believes, as I do, that facts matter in governance. She believes that evidence should drive health policy. And that the job of a public servant is to serve the public, not a partisan agenda.
That sounds basic. It shouldn't be controversial. And yet, what we're watching in Washington right now – the deliberate erosion of public health institutions, the rewriting of scientific consensus to fit ideological convenience – is what happens when leaders stop holding up their end of that compact. People like RFK, Jr. aren't just wrong about science and health. They're breaking something that's vitally needed and genuinely hard to put back together.
Jasmine has been clear-eyed and steady in the face of all of it. That's rare. And it's exactly what this moment requires.
Here's the reality: the same forces working to undermine our public health systems and democratic institutions nationally are working just as hard to defeat her. They know what's at stake if a scientist with Jasmine's integrity goes to Congress.
So do I. And I hope you do too.
If you believe science should guide health policy, that elections should be free and fair, and that government exists to serve people and not the other way around, then I'd ask you to stand with Jasmine today.
Chip in to support Jasmine Clark and help send a scientist to Congress. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]

Pete Buttigieg

subject: Trump is saying the quiet part out loud

body:
Gas is averaging $4.50 a gallon, inflation is at a three-year high, and Trump just said he doesn’t even think about working families.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260518-1&t=1&akid=3493%2E587540%2E8AvXbr)
Peter,
Trump just laid it all out on the table.
**When he was asked how much Americans’ financial struggles are motivating him to make a deal to end the illegal war in Iran, he said:__Not even a little bit.__**
This war has already cost taxpayers an estimated $30 billion. Working families are being forced to cut back on groceries, skip doctors visits they can’t afford, and watch their safety nets disappear with every attempt by this administration to gut social services.
They’re being squeezed at every corner, and Trump just said he doesn’t give a damn.
This is why the MAGA base is imploding. This is why young voters are souring on Trump like never before. It’s becoming more clear by the day that he will betray their interests without a second thought, because working people were never the point._Power was._ And in a political system that privileges the wealthy, Trump has never fought for anyone who can’t afford to buy his loyalty.
But here’s what he doesn’t understand: every person has their breaking point. When people feel betrayed, when their voices aren’t being heard, they don’t just get angry — they get organized. And they start looking for leaders who will actually mean what they say and provide a vision for the future that's worth believing in, instead of treating working people as an afterthought.
That’s who Leaders We Deserve backs. Candidates who come from the communities they’re fighting for and refuse corporate money because that’s not who they work for. Leaders who don’t have to be asked if working families are on their mind — because they’re the whole reason they ran in the first place.

| | I recently wrapped up my Official 12 County, 12 Day Whistle-Stop Listening Tour across Eastern Washington. It was a wonderful opportunity to hear directly from the people I serve. Over those twelve days, I met with local business leaders, elected officials, and hundreds of dedicated constituents in communities throughout our district. We had productive conversations on the issues that matter most— strengthening our economy, supporting agriculture, improving infrastructure, and keeping our families safe and thriving. I’m truly grateful for every conversation and came home energized and committed to delivering real results for Eastern Washington in Congress.
---
|
---
| |
# Honored to Attend the Whitman County Lincoln Dinner
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | On May 8th, I had the honor of attending the Lincoln Day celebration in Whitman County. It was a wonderful evening filled with great conversation, shared values, and tremendous enthusiasm from Republicans across the county. I enjoyed connecting with longtime supporters and passionate conservatives who are committed to the principles that make our country strong. Events like this remind me why I’m in this fight.

---
|
---
| |
# A Great Day at Cheney Mayfest
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | It was great to join the community at Cheney Mayfest on May 9. From the lively family festivities in downtown Cheney to the wonderful conversations with so many local residents, it was a fantastic reminder of the strong spirit and tight-knit community that makes Cheney so special. Hearing directly from you about the everyday issues that matter most- supporting our schools, growing small businesses, and keeping our families safe- reminds me why I love serving this community.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Soaking Up Small-Town Spirit at Wilbur’s Wild Bill Goose Days
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | This past weekend I had a wonderful time with my family at Wilbur’s Wild Bill Goose Days in Lincoln County. I started the day with the 5K Wild Goose Chase run, and then had a great time at the parade along with Eleanor, all our children, and some fantastic volunteers who took time from their Saturday to come out and help.
I counted a lot of high-fives from excited kids along the parade route, and we all enjoyed the smiles, laughter, and community pride on full display. Events like Wild Bill Goose Days are a reminder of what makes Eastern Washington so special— hardworking families, rich traditions, and neighbors who truly care for one another. Thank you to everyone who came out to say hello!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Fun at Spangle Days
---
|
---
| | Team Baumgartner had a wonderful time at Spangle Days on Saturday morning, joining the community for this cherished annual festival in the heart of the Palouse. It was a great opportunity to connect with the hardworking local families while celebrating the town’s proud traditions. We were also proud to support an event that helps raise funds for the local food bank. Thank you to everyone in Spangle for the warm welcome!

This special event honors our nation’s flag and the values of patriotism, freedom, and service that unite our communities.
**Saturday June 20:**[_**Medical Lake Founders Day Parade:**_](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=c71418ef34&e=5a45b9550e) Join Team Baumgartner at 10 am for Medical Lake Founders Day Parade in Spokane County. name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: We don’t need more billionaire-funded politicians
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260518-2275-foote&t=1001&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

We just learned that we will have not one, but two opponents in our
Democratic primary. But with neither having filed a required fundraising
report with the Federal Election Commission, it leads us to ask, who is
funding them?

At least one of our opponents has a history of working for billionaires
and corporate polluters while accepting money from oil lobbyists, the
banking industry, and DTE Energy.

Voters deserve a voice in Congress who will always put their interests
ahead of Big Money and the billionaire bullies. And that’s what I’ve done
throughout my career fighting for you.

In the past, people have been offered tens of millions of dollars to run
against me. With just over three months until Election Day, I need your
urgent support right now.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260518-movement.eziQaj&refcode=em20260518-2275&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]Can you chip in $3 to the Squad Victory Fund to show our
opponents and their wealthy backers that we’re ready for the fight ahead?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260518-movement.eziQaj&refcode=em20260518-2275&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]Contribute ››

Big Banks, greedy corporate polluters, and genocide enablers aren’t shy
about funding my opponents. That’s because I haven’t been shy about taking
on their special interests.

I’m part of the House Financial Services Committee, where I’ve held
executives at J.P. Morgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Bank of
America, Morgan Stanley, and CitiGroup accountable for how their
investments in dirty fossil fuel projects are contributing to
environmental racism.

They’ve poisoned our air, water, and soil in frontline communities,
endangering our public health—and I’ll keep taking them on and fighting
for environmental justice.

Billionaires may spend millions funding my opponents too. That’s because
I’ve never been afraid to take them on, including when I successfully
pushed the Koch brothers to fully clean up and remove toxic waste from
Detroit’s riverfront.

We don’t need any more billionaire-funded politicians in Washington.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260518-movement.eziQaj&refcode=em20260518-2275&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]Let’s show that we’re ready for the fight ahead! Chip in
$3 to the Squad Victory Fund and let voters know that we’re
fighting for them every single day.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260518-movement.eziQaj&refcode=em20260518-2275&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]Contribute ››

Together, we will show billionaire bullies that people power will always
defeat their Big Money interests.

Always serving you,

Rashida

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260518-movement.eziQaj&refcode=em20260518-2275&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1024&akid=2275%2E342411%2ElDkI3S ]A picture of Rashida Tlaib.

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: info@squadvictoryfund.com

name: Hannah Servedio
subject: Excitement is building
body:
OUR CHANCE TO WIN

Friend, reproductive freedom and abortion rights have been under brutal attack all across the country this year.

But in Virginia, we have the chance to ENSHRINE reproductive freedom in the Virginia Constitution the November!

So what does it take to make it happen? What does it take to WIN? To secure our freedoms?

It takes voters. It takes voices. It takes the hundreds of people who came out to rally this Saturday at our official campaign launch in Richmond. It takes you!

And it takes dollars. Dollars to fire up our movement and to win at the polls on November 3. Can you chip in a few dollars today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=rally3b]

HERE'S MY DONATION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=rally3b]

The energy at our official campaign launch this weekend was contagious. I hope you're feeling the excitement. I sure am.

Virginians for Reproductive Freedom is leading the movement to amend Virginia's constitution and protect our reproductive freedom once and for all! And we’re just getting started! Watch our campaign launch video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=44x68hAWbss [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=44x68hAWbss]

We know that victory takes all of us — activists and door-knockers and donors — working together. I’d be personally grateful if you’d support our movement with a gift. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=rally3b]

I SUPPORT REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=rally3b]

Right now, we have the momentum. But we also need resources to see our campaign through to victory. Generations have fought to guarantee our freedoms. It’s up to us to make it happen this November. Please donate if you can! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=rally3b]

Let’s make history together.
Hannah Servedio
Organizing Director

P.S. Let’s keep showing up in force to prove that reproductive freedom in Virginia is something we’ll rally for, vote for, and fight for. Thank you for joining us.

Visit our website [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]

Virginians for Reproductive Freedom
600 Pennsylvania Ave SE Unit 15845
Washington, DC 20003

Hey folks,
**Adam Mockler** joined me and we dug into the latest Trump insanity -- the billion-dollar White House ballroom, the reports about a secret underground medical facility, and the increasingly obvious signs that something is very wrong behind the scenes. We talked about Trump's anger, his late-night posting spirals, the economic chaos hitting working families, and why the people around him keep scrambling to clean up the mess afterward.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down Trump's escalating public anger and why his recent behavior feels fundamentally different -- more erratic, more impulsive, and harder for even his allies to explain away.
* [**00:03:18**] Adam walks through the shocking report that Trump's massive White House ballroom project may also include a secret underground hospital and medical facility tied directly to the president.
* [**00:06:36**] We get into Trump openly saying he's "not thinking about" Americans' financial struggles -- while inflation, gas prices, and economic anxiety keep rising for working families.
* [**00:10:52**] The conversation turns to Trump's late-night posting binges, reports of him falling asleep during meetings, and the growing panic among Republicans forced to defend the indefensible.
* [**00:16:17**] We close on the bigger picture: exploding national debt, taxpayer money flowing into Trump vanity projects, and why Democrats cannot afford to normalize any of this going forward.

This episode is really about accountability -- and about refusing to let outrage fatigue numb us into accepting corruption, incompetence, or cruelty as normal. We talked about media failures, economic pain, political cowardice, and the growing disconnect between what Americans are living through and what Trump seems focused on. If you care about protecting democracy, building a fairer economy, and having honest conversations that don't sugarcoat reality, this one is essential listening.

body:
Guess who got $0?
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=140%2E127862%2EtGWeHP)
Folks,
Southwest Gas and NV Energy, two of the biggest utility companies in our state, sent a **_$40,000_** check to support MAGA Governor Joe Lombardo’s campaign.
Guess who got **$0**? Me. ✋🏾
Those same utilities are pushing for rate structures that could spike monthly bills for Nevada families.
Lombardo won't say a word about these peak demand charges, but my office is already fighting them in court. And if I'm elected governor, I'll halt them completely.
That’s why they’re not rushing to send our campaign a check, and honestly, I wouldn’t want it any other way.
I grew up knowing what it felt like when the bills were too high, and the money wasn't there.
So when the utilities come looking for a governor who'll look the other way while your energy bills climb? **That's not going to be me.**
While Lombardo stuffs his campaign war chest with massive $40k checks, I’m counting on regular people like you to fuel our movement.
[**Can you chip in $5 today to help us unseat Lombardo and win?**](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260518_1_ak.OF_Gx-&amount=5&refcode=em20260518-139&t=2&akid=140%2E127862%2EtGWeHP)

Aaron

Fellow Conservative,
_
**What happens when reliably red states start slipping away?**

We’ve seen it before, the other way around: **In 2016, Trump flipped Michigan and Wisconsin. In 2024, he took Nevada for the first time in two decades.**

Democrats didn’t have a contingency plan, and they paid for it.

But, what if the script flips and puts Republicans in the hot seat?

Recent polls show **Texas, Mississippi, Alaska, Georgia, and North Carolina — long-time Republican strongholds** — are all at serious risk of flipping or becoming highly competitive this November.

**If we lose even one or two of these firewall states, Republicans cannot afford to lose a single additional seat.

That’s why I’m asking you to support my race in Minnesota** — a race that could quietly become one of the most important insurance policies for keeping the Senate majority.

As a former Navy SEAL, I don’t believe in hoping for the best. **I prepare for the worst and fight to win.** With your help, we can flip this seat, double the number of SEALs in the U.S. Senate, and give our party critical reinforcements no matter what happens in the South or the Far North.

clean_body: When all else fails, that’s when it pays off to have a very, very good insurance policy. | Fellow Conservative, What happens when reliably red states start slipping away? We’ve seen it before, the other way around: In 2016, Trump flipped Michigan and Wisconsin. In 2024, he took Nevada for the first time in two decades. Democrats didn’t have a contingency plan, and they paid for it. But, what if the script flips and puts Republicans in the hot seat? Recent polls show Texas, Mississippi, Alaska, Georgia, and North Carolina — long-time Republican strongholds — are all at serious risk of flipping or becoming highly competitive this November. If we lose even one or two of these firewall states, Republicans cannot afford to lose a single additional seat. That’s why I’m asking you to support my race in Minnesota — a race that could quietly become one of the most important insurance policies for keeping the Senate majority. As a former Navy SEAL, I don’t believe in hoping for the best. I prepare for the worst and fight to win. With your help, we can flip this seat, double the number of SEALs in the U.S. Senate, and give our party critical reinforcements no matter what happens in the South or the Far North. That’s why I’m writing today: Every dollar will be used to protect and expand our Senate majority — even if some of our traditional strongholds fall. It’s a new generation, but the struggle for civil rights is far from over. In
the wake of the Supreme Court decision demolishing the 1965 Voting Rights Act,
MAGA gerrymanders are being rushed through Southern state legislatures,
including the Tennessee Legislature’s elimination of the only Black-majority
district in the state.

This moment calls on all of us to take action to protect our fundamental freedom
to choose our own leaders, so we can fight back against environmental injustice
and protect the health of disenfranchised communities across the country.

Act Now: Demand Congress take urgent action to restore and protect voting rights. https://links.messages.lcv. clean_body: Our mistake, Peter | = Peter, quick correction from us: The bad news: We got a little too excited about tomorrow’s primaries and accidentally jumped the gun in our last email. Primary Election Day is tomorrow, Tuesday, May 19 — not today. The good news: That means you have one more day to help power Democratic pro-choice women running in critical primary elections across the country tomorrow night. Let me share a few reasons why this time will be different: , during my first run for Senate, I was a longtime Congressman with little to no name ID. This cycle, I will be entering the race as an established candidate who earned the support of nearly 2.7 million Michiganders. , President Trump's victory in my state was a watershed moment. Michigan was long seen as a key pillar to the “blue wall” – in other words, a state that consistently votes Democratic. We’re entering the midterms with an entirely different landscape. , the Democrats are already running with their tail between their legs. Gary Peters, our incumbent Senator, decided he would rather quit his job than face me in a race he was sure he would lose. This open race is a Republican’s best chance to flip a Michigan seat since 1994, Friend. If I’m going to win, I will need a top-notch team by my side and it would mean the world if you would join me. I’m ready to get to work on day one and be a man you will be proud to call Michigan's next Senator. Thank you for reading, Mike Rogers

May 18, 2026

The world does not belong to the beautiful and the brilliant, it belongs to the persistent. This is not to say that my good friend [Dr. Mike Goldstein](https://substack.com/redirect/65d94288-cbae-4f63-be69-9afcdde6d393?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is not beautiful and brilliant. After all, he looks fifteen years younger than his seventy-five years. And he is not only an eye surgeon who trained with the one of the most famous eye surgeons on the planet - Jose Barraquer - but also a lawyer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7540cb51-4422-4dbd-a768-103bcfb48fed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dr. Mike Goldstein

But he certainly is persistent as he embarks on his fourth attempt to replace Congressman Jim Himes. In 2022, when he failed to receive the necessary 15% at the Republican Convention (Connecticut is one of the few states that allows this feudal remnant), he and his volunteers literally manned garbage dumps to acquire enough signatures and forced a primary against the charismatic former Darien First Selectman Jamie Stevenson, and garnered a respectable 40%.
But Mike's refusal to allow Party Insiders determine his fate came back to bite him when he ran again in 2024 as he was still unable to win the Republican Convention and lost by four votes on the second ballot to Tea Party firebrand Bob MacGuffie. But superior organizing skills and endless door knocking enabled Mike to defeat Mr. MacGuffie in the primary.
But 2024 was not a Republican year in Fairfield County and Mike's name followed President Trump's name on the ballot and he garnered 38%, the same as President Trump.
But time heals most wounds and Mike was able to win the Republican Convention this year with 62% of the vote against another Tea Party firebrand and MacGuffie acolyte, [Dan Miressi](https://substack.com/redirect/dcf42789-3127-44fa-a21a-b0e5e1b095c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). At the time of this writing, this former hockey professional and hockey coach plans to primary Mike.
Mike was never a professional athlete, but he has cared for them. As his office is in Manhattan, he was asked to clear boxers for matches by making sure their eyes were healthy. Thus, he has interesting anecdotes about such patients as Evander Holyfield and George Foreman.
As a physician, Mike's campaign focuses on health care affordability. But as a lawyer, he grasps this issue as few other politicians can.
He recently wrote: "As a physician and attorney who has been concerned about the dangers of greater and greater consolidation of the healthcare industry and its anticompetitive consequences, I have always be disappointed with the Federal Government's unwillingness and inability to stop both the vertical and horizontal integration of health insurance companies.
Health insurance companies have expanded and acquired other insurance companies (horizontal integration) and have purchased or built other kinds of healthcare businesses including Pharmacy Benefit Managers (which control drug prices and copays) and acquire or create medical practices (vertical integration)."
But that's not Mike's only issue. He has an encyclopedic grasp of energy issues and will make it his mission to decrease them in Fairfield County if elected. As he wrote:

"Connecticut families pay 60% more for electricity because federal policy blocked the pipelines that would deliver affordable energy. That's not a market failure -- that's a government failure. I will fight to unblock pipeline capacity and end the ideology-first energy policies that are bankrupting Connecticut households."

And antisemitism is raising its ugly head, and Mike will make that an issue. The father of his charming wife Belle fought the Nazi's in the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising and actually dug a bullet out of his leg with a penknife. Her mother and two aunts survived the Concentration Camps. Yet his primary opponent, Dan Miressi, once referred to Mike as "goldig."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ebbad488-4815-4dbf-918a-f2bb25327adc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dan Miressi's Twitter Post Calling Dr. Mike Goldstein "goldig"

Jim Himes probably thinks he can coast again. He has never been seriously challenged since defeating Chris Shays in 2008. But a lot has changed. And since 2024, there has been a seismic shift in political power due to AI (Artificial Intelligence). Mike will be able to get his message out with AI generated videos for dirt cheap. Congressman Himes will have hoards of money, thanks to his fellow Goldman Sachs cronies who like Congressman Himes, remain filthy rich due to the taxpayer bailouts of 2008.
Plus, Congressman Himes does little to nothing for Fairfield County. He is too busy appearing on liberal cable network shows attacking President Trump while pretending he has all the solutions to the world's problems. But what is his solution to all the traffic in Fairfield County? Noise barriers! You can't make this up.

clean_body: He's Tanned, Ready and Rested | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more He's Tanned, Ready and Rested | | | May 18 | | | | | | | | | | | | May 18, 2026 The world does not belong to the beautiful and the brilliant, it belongs to the persistent. This is not to say that my good friend is not beautiful and brilliant. After all, he looks fifteen years younger than his seventy-five years. And he is not only an eye surgeon who trained with the one of the most famous eye surgeons on the planet - Jose Barraquer - but also a lawyer. | | ---|---|--- Dr. Mike Goldstein But he certainly is persistent as he embarks on his fourth attempt to replace Congressman Jim Himes. In 2022, when he failed to receive the necessary 15% at the Republican Convention (Connecticut is one of the few states that allows this feudal remnant), he and his volunteers literally manned garbage dumps to acquire enough signatures and forced a primary against the charismatic former Darien First Selectman Jamie Stevenson, and garnered a respectable 40%. But Mike's refusal to allow Party Insiders determine his fate came back to bite him when he ran again in 2024 as he was still unable to win the Republican Convention and lost by four votes on the second ballot to Tea Party firebrand Bob MacGuffie. But superior organizing skills and endless door knocking enabled Mike to defeat Mr. MacGuffie in the primary. But 2024 was not a Republican year in Fairfield County and Mike's name followed President Trump's name on the ballot and he garnered 38%, the same as President Trump. But time heals most wounds and Mike was able to win the Republican Convention this year with 62% of the vote against another Tea Party firebrand and MacGuffie acolyte, . At the time of this writing, this former hockey professional and hockey coach plans to primary Mike. Mike was never a professional athlete, but he has cared for them. As his office is in Manhattan, he was asked to clear boxers for matches by making sure their eyes were healthy. Thus, he has interesting anecdotes about such patients as Evander Holyfield and George Foreman. As a physician, Mike's campaign focuses on health care affordability. But as a lawyer, he grasps this issue as few other politicians can. He recently wrote: "As a physician and attorney who has been concerned about the dangers of greater and greater consolidation of the healthcare industry and its anticompetitive consequences, I have always be disappointed with the Federal Government's unwillingness and inability to stop both the vertical and horizontal integration of health insurance companies. Health insurance companies have expanded and acquired other insurance companies (horizontal integration) and have purchased or built other kinds of healthcare businesses including Pharmacy Benefit Managers (which control drug prices and copays) and acquire or create medical practices (vertical integration)." But that's not Mike's only issue. He has an encyclopedic grasp of energy issues and will make it his mission to decrease them in Fairfield County if elected. As he wrote: "Connecticut families pay 60% more for electricity because federal policy blocked the pipelines that would deliver affordable energy. That's not a market failure -- that's a government failure. I will fight to unblock pipeline capacity and end the ideology-first energy policies that are bankrupting Connecticut households." And antisemitism is raising its ugly head, and Mike will make that an issue. The father of his charming wife Belle fought the Nazi's in the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising and actually dug a bullet out of his leg with a penknife. Her mother and two aunts survived the Concentration Camps. Yet his primary opponent, Dan Miressi, once referred to Mike as "goldig." | | ---|---|--- Dan Miressi's Twitter Post Calling Dr. Mike Goldstein "goldig" Jim Himes probably thinks he can coast again. He has never been seriously challenged since defeating Chris Shays in 2008. But a lot has changed. And since 2024, there has been a seismic shift in political power due to AI (Artificial Intelligence). Mike will be able to get his message out with AI generated videos for dirt cheap. Congressman Himes will have hoards of money, thanks to his fellow Goldman Sachs cronies who like Congressman Himes, remain filthy rich due to the taxpayer bailouts of 2008. Plus, Congressman Himes does little to nothing for Fairfield County. He is too busy appearing on liberal cable network shows attacking President Trump while pretending he has all the solutions to the world's problems. But what is his solution to all the traffic in Fairfield County? Noise barriers! name: AOC
subject: Corporations spend money because they want votes.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When corporations and lobbyists spend money in an election, they expect something in return of those they spend it for.
**They spend that money because they want votes**.
They want votes for insurance companies who profit while working families struggle to afford care.
They want votes to slowly weaken protections and to look the other way as corporations and modern-day barons consolidate more wealth and power than ever before.
And in the case of AIPAC, defense contractors, and their allies, they want votes for war and silence while American tax dollars go to the genocide and displacement of Palestinians and the invasion of Iran as the global economy descends into chaos.
Because somehow in Washington, D.C. — I will tell you firsthand — there is always money for conflict, war, and military escalation in the interest of the powerful.
And yet, **there is never enough money for healthcare** , housing, childcare, wages, infrastructure, bridges, water, air, power, electricity — none of it.
We don't have to live like this anymore**.
We can make a new world, a better country, where we can fight for the dignity of all people.
That means that we must choose to out-organize the oligarchy. We will and must do away with the power of big money.

Remember to Vote if you can. and if you live near on of these candidates, consider helping them out on this very important day.

[ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_call_remind&n=5) Forward Democrat Ron Ruman is running in a special election, which will be held on primary day. name: Gina Hinojosa HQ
subject: Born and raised in RGV
body:
Gina’s been winning fights for her entire life.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
This is Gina. She grew up in the Rio Grande Valley, attending Brownsville public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=1&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)_Picture day at Egly Elementary in Brownsville, TX_
At an early age, Gina’s grandmother taught her an important lesson: _No te dejes. Fight back_. It’s a lesson that Gina has carried with her for her entire life — and it’s what she’s doing today as she runs to be the next Governor of Texas.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=2&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)_Born and raised in the Valley_
Gina never planned to run for office. But when her son’s elementary school was threatened for closure by state budget cuts, she rallied other parents, ran for Austin ISD School Board, and won. She kept her son’s school open, along with every other public school in the district.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=3&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)_The Austin Chronicle endorsed her race for school board_
But neighborhood schools kept closing across the state because Republican leaders kept diverting Texas tax dollars away from schools. So Gina ran for a seat in the Texas House of Representatives — and she won. In 2019, she helped win an investment of more than $11 billion in Texas public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=4&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)_On the floor of the Texas State House_
**Now, Gina is the official Democratic nominee running to unseat Greg Abbott.** She’s been winning tough fights for her entire life, and she has what it takes to do it again this November.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=5&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)_Years later, she’s still fighting back. No te dejes._
A new poll shows Gina tied with Abbott — in a district he last won by 10 points.
That means we have the momentum behind us, but with only six months until Election Day, Gina’s relying on your urgent support to scale up her campaign before it’s too late.
**[If you’re in this fight with Gina, will you please donate $5 right now to power her fight to November? Any amount you can contribute will go a long way in building a campaign strong enough to flip Texas.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&refcode=em20260518-1143&amount=5&t=6&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260518_2_bio.Eq7Ea9&amount=5&refcode=em20260518-1143&t=25&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)
Gratefully yours,
– Gina Hinojosa HQ

[ Donate » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20260518-2&t=26&refcode2=1143_299639_XpRjWS&akid=1143%2E299639%2EXpRjWS)

The 2026 Connecticut Republican Convention demonstrated something many believed was no longer possible in Connecticut politics: **UNITY**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f3da48ab-3f00-4176-b38b-b51ac524f202?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
###### Pictured - Gubernatorial Candidate Ryan Fazio with Lieutenant Candidate Matt Corey
As the Republican-endorsed candidate for Congress in Connecticut's Fourth Congressional District, it was truly inspiring to witness a convention defined not by division, but by professionalism, respect, and a collective desire to move Connecticut forward.
At the convention, Ryan Fazio was officially declared the Republican-endorsed candidate for Governor of Connecticut. Midway through the voting process for Lieutenant Governor, candidate Tim Ackert conceded, paving the way for Matt Corey to secure the endorsement.
## A Convention Marked by Respect and Professionalism
For Republicans in attendance -- and for those watching statewide -- the convention displayed one of the highest levels of professionalism and mutual respect many have seen in decades of Connecticut politics.
Former gubernatorial candidate Betsy McCaughey delivered a gracious concession speech praising Senator Fazio as a true professional and principled opponent who campaigned on the issues while honoring President Reagan's Eleventh Commandment: _" Thou shalt not speak ill of another Republican."_
McCaughey made clear that the real political challenge is not within the Republican Party, but against the policies of Governor Ned Lamont and the direction many believe is harming Connecticut residents through rising costs, affordability challenges, and continued outmigration.
Senator Fazio's acceptance speech continued that same message of unity. He emphasized that Republicans, while in the minority statewide, can only succeed through coalition-building, discipline, and a shared vision for Connecticut's future.
## Concessions That Strengthened the Party
The Lieutenant Governor race carried a similar tone. As vote totals became increasingly clear, Matt Corey appeared poised to earn the party endorsement -- a milestone achieved this time at convention rather than through the primary process, something Corey knows well from years of political perseverance.
## Tim Ackert's Message of Service Before Self
Tim Ackert then took the stage and delivered one of the most authentic and impactful speeches of the day. Speaking candidly about his journey as an Air Force veteran, small business owner, and public servant, Ackert reminded attendees what service truly means. His remarks reflected perseverance (after taking several cycles to get to Hartford), humility, and the understanding that service must always come before self-interest.
In many ways, Ackert's concession speech may have been even more powerful than some of the victory speeches because it reinforced a critical truth: **collectively, Republicans are stronger together than they are divided as individuals.**
That message may ultimately determine whether conservative voices can truly compete and succeed in November.
## Unity Beyond the Convention Hall
The Connecticut Republican Party remains a coalition with many factions, regional interests, strengths, and weaknesses. The consequences of fragmentation have been clear for years: losses in the State House, no federal representation, and limited success at the top of the ticket.
But if Republicans can continue embracing the spirit of unity demonstrated at this convention -- from State Representative races to the Governor's office, with all five congressional candidates working collaboratively as a team -- 2026 could become the year Connecticut begins to change course.
## No Single Person Controls a Party
It is important to remember that no single person controls a party. Every Republican -- and every unaffiliated voter who shares Republican values -- has a responsibility in shaping the outcome this November.
That responsibility belongs to candidates, RTCs, State Central members, volunteers, and individual Republicans alike. We must get the message out and show Connecticut there is a way out.
## The People of Connecticut Decide November
At this point, the party has completed the endorsement process, but the people of Connecticut will ultimately determine the outcome. The responsibility now shifts from convention halls to neighborhoods, town committees, grassroots volunteers, and voters across the state.
Let us continue the spirit of unity demonstrated at this convention -- especially on the same day that Donald Trump declared a National Day of Prayer as part of the celebration leading into the United States' 250th anniversary.
Connecticut faces serious challenges, but there remains a path forward. If Republicans, unaffiliated voters, and those who believe in fiscal responsibility, affordability, opportunity, and accountable government work together, Connecticut can once again become a state people are proud to build their future in.
## Young Republicans Are Building the Next Chapter

###### Patrick Burland - Chairman of CT Young Republicans addresses the Young Republicans -
###### Also pictured - CTGOP Chairman Ben Proto
Equally important was the strong contingent of College Republicans and Young Republicans in attendance -- serving as delegates, campaign team members, volunteers, and guests. Their presence reflected the energy of a new generation ready to build Connecticut's future.
That energy was represented by Geoffrey Medeiros, Chairman of the College Republicans, and Patrick Burland, Chairman of the Connecticut Young Republicans.
> "After years of Democrat control and failed leadership, Connecticut Republicans have a unique opportunity to flip our great state. The presence of our College Republicans here at the convention is so important, and with the momentum on our side, we will help push all of our great candidates over the finish line."
> _**Geoffrey Medeiros, Chairman of the College Republicans**_
> "At every level of our party, from Republican Town Committees to our nominee for governor, Young Republicans are stepping up because they know this election is our opportunity to make Connecticut affordable and safe again. The Democrats are in complete disarray as voters of all ages and backgrounds are abandoning their backwards policies and embracing Senator Fazio's plan to make Connecticut the best place to live, work, and raise a family once again."
> _**
> Patrick Burland, Chairman of the Connecticut Young Republicans**_
These young Republicans were not there simply to hear old stories about when Connecticut was once red. They were there because they believe new glory days can be built ahead.
That enthusiasm was visible beyond the convention floor. Their event at Michael Jordan's Sports Bar was packed, energetic, and full of excitement -- a clear sign that the next generation of Republicans is not waiting for permission to lead. _**That event was also to launch their Young Republican Caucus.**_

###### Senate Minority Leader - Stephen Harding - Addresses CT Young Republicans
These Young Republicans also understand that energy alone is not enough. The next generation needs guidance, mentorship, and support from the right voices -- leaders who want to build them up, not hold them back.
At the same time, the party must embrace the social media, communications, and influencer-marketing skill sets that younger Republicans naturally bring to the table. Those tools are no longer optional in modern politics -- they are essential to organizing, messaging, voter engagement, and ultimately winning in November.
And some of these young leaders will not just volunteer, post, organize, or advise. They will step up and run for state seats themselves -- bringing new energy, new skills, and a new generation of leadership to Hartford.

subject: Are the rumors are true? (And is Bill Foster is panicking?)
body:

| | | | | | Dear Friends,
Wow, this has been a crazy year. A year ago, I never imagined that a campaign started by the mayor of the small town of Elburn would grow into one of the most competitive congressional races in Illinois.
However, this race is getting closer every day. Political experts once believed Democrats had a comfortable advantage in this district. Now, they’re saying this district is becoming much more competitive and could realistically be won by Republicans with the right support and momentum. We are even hearing rumors that the experts may even change the official rating on this race.
This means we have a real opportunity to defeat Bill Foster and bring new leadership to this district - but only if we have the resources to compete.
We must raise [$500,000](https://us.list-manage.com/wDXVXFjpWyU?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20) by the end of June to prove this campaign has what it takes to win!
If you’re ready to help flip this district, [now is the time to donate](https://us.list-manage.com/13QbRLnGxnd?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20).
[Let’s shock and flip Illinois together!](https://us.list-manage.com/zcoTmHCjGaN?e=fa724b03ca&c2id=02d8faed9a08421996be4d5fd2cd9a20)

body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260518_2.NwT6Fj&refcode=em20260518-2&t=1&akid=6710%2E582294%2ENtNgAF)
Folks, it’s Senator Adam Schiff.
I’m reaching out because my friend Chris Pappas is in the fight of his life — **and the outcome could decide control of the Senate.**
National Republicans have zeroed in on New Hampshire’s open Senate seat, and they’re lining up their billionaire donors to flood the airwaves with attacks and misinformation.

clean_body: From Navy helicopter pilot to Congress | Peter, I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book. I truly hate having to send messages like this, but I really appreciate your time! My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff. Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: My name is Jen Kiggans. I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom. And that is exactly WHY I ran for Congress in 2022. I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America! Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District RED in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight. Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent JUST announced she raised over $1.75 MILLION in the first quarter alone. They will stop at absolutely nothing to win. So today, I'm recruiting YOU to join my mission to save our country from the Democrats' grasp once and for all. That is why I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor. | | As a Navy Vet, I've never turned away from a tough fight, and trust me, I won't start now. ---

For months, Mainers were told not to believe what they were seeing.
Vacant offices. Questionable billing. Nonprofits refusing to fully answer where money went. Politically connected organizations receiving taxpayer dollars. Elected officials staying quiet. Journalists being threatened for asking questions.
Then Homeland Security visited Lewiston.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/671f540a-c8d5-4093-b0c8-60ac2ddd4e4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now, after Vice President JD Vance traveled to Bangor to speak directly about fraud, waste, and abuse in government programs, Maine has been pushed into the center of a national anti-fraud crackdown.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d541a4c6-416d-41ce-8487-f71920c65eed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For many residents, whistleblowers, and reporters who have been sounding the alarm, Vance's visit did not create the controversy.
It validated it.
At the center of the storm is Gateway Community Services, the Portland - Lewiston-based organization that became one of the most closely watched MaineCare scandals in the state.
The Maine Wire repeatedly raised questions about Gateway, its billing practices, its operations, and the broader taxpayer-funded network connected to it.
Maine Wire reporter Jon Fetherston repeatedly went directly to Gov. Janet Mills' office asking questions about Gateway Community Services, its billing practices, and the broader fraud concerns surrounding MaineCare-funded providers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/61cf2813-cca3-4833-898d-994ccdfa54eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He did not receive answers.
No direct response. No clear explanation. No public accounting.
Yet after months of pressure, and after it became clear that Fetherston and The Maine Wire were not going to stop asking questions, the Mills administration quietly reacted by cutting off MaineCare funding to Gateway, citing a credible allegation of fraud.
That silence matters.
If the problem was not serious, why did the state cut off funding?

[](https://substack.com/redirect/d946b708-0b2d-47dd-ba7b-174ace73651e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/aaa49973-2fd0-432d-b1fb-271881498b3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The answer remains unclear.
But what is clear is that President Donald Trump's administration has made fraud a national priority.
Vice President Vance has been placed at the center of that effort, leading the charge against waste, abuse, and improper payments in taxpayer-funded programs.
In Bangor, Vance pointed directly to Maine as an example of what happens when state leaders fail to protect public dollars.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fea2ab85-c8fe-4f5d-9871-2a00dd34640d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
He also referenced the case of an interpreter in Maine accused of stealing roughly $15 million while allegedly providing no real services, a case that has become a symbol of the larger concern that Maine's oversight systems were asleep while fraudsters got rich.
