| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f6c29251-83f8-4562-bdc9-70ab3d59ba2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dr. Mehmet Oz has also put Maine on notice as federal healthcare officials increase scrutiny of Medicaid and Medicare fraud nationwide.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5cb11aba-aede-4360-b10a-e00a4ef1153b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For the crowd in Bangor, the issue was not abstract.
At one point, News Center Maine reporter Phil Hirschkorn asked Vance what else he had to offer on fraud. The question was met with loud boos from the audience, a clear sign that many Mainers believe the issue has been ignored, minimized, or dismissed for far too long.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c3add417-27f3-4883-acd5-0c645bba990e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Vance also went out of his way to mention Jon Fetherston and Steve Robinson of The Maine Wire for their work exposing fraud in Maine, a remarkable moment, given the response from Maine's liberal legacy media.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f79a98a9-c887-49f4-9a36-0490e904a740?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The fraud stories in Maine have now drawn national attention from outlets including Fox News, NewsNation, and Newsmax. Yet much of Maine's local legacy media continues to frame major parts of the scandal as merely "alleged," even after state action, federal attention, Homeland Security visits, congressional oversight scrutiny, and direct comments from the Vice President of the United States.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5a10fbad-d710-4636-9601-44c885c8b1b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Rather than treat Vance's visit as confirmation that fraud is a serious and growing issue, much of the local legacy media response has been skepticism, denial, or an attempt to downplay the scope of the problem.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8f8aa959-867f-4b47-9e47-60ad8b88144b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
No Democratic candidate for governor has been pressed in debates to answer directly for Maine's fraud crisis.
Not one.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a191ff8a-57e5-47b3-8568-23bd5059da4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Yet the Vice President of the United States came to Maine and publicly acknowledged the work of the reporters who have been asking the questions Augusta would not answer.
That should tell Mainers everything.
The frustration is not limited to healthcare.
In Lewiston, nonprofit accountability remains a major unresolved issue following the October 2023 mass shooting.
Millions of dollars poured into relief efforts after the tragedy. Yet many survivors, residents, and advocates continue to ask where the money went, who received it, and why some organizations have not provided clearer answers.
Former Lewiston City Councilor Iman Osman, who has faced gun-related charges, has been among the figures tied to broader questions about nonprofit influence and accountability in the city.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7423c930-88c0-43b2-8700-98142081058a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The same political and nonprofit circles have also drawn scrutiny because of their relationships with candidates, activists, and organizations that hold influence in Maine politics.
Graham Platner has faced criticism over appearances and associations involving figures connected to Gateway and Lewiston-area nonprofit networks.
Platner had State Rep. Deqa Dhalac seated in the front row at his campaign rally with Sen. Elizabeth Warren, even as Dhalac has drawn scrutiny connected to the Congressional House Oversight Committee's examination of Maine fraud concerns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/765ad2d0-c03b-4b04-888d-ff5443a64206?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Platner has also walked shoulder to shoulder at events with Iman Osman.
Dhalac and Osman are two figures repeatedly mentioned by critics in connection with Maine's broader fraud and nonprofit accountability scandals.
Yet Platner has stayed silent on the issue.
That silence is not a small political footnote. It goes directly to the center of Platner's campaign message.
How can Platner claim he is going to fight oligarchs and amass the power of the people if he refuses to directly address the fraud concerns now consuming Maine -- or if he continues running in political circles connected to figures and organizations attached to those controversies?
If Platner wants to run as a fighter for working Mainers, he should be able to answer a simple question: will he stand with taxpayers and vulnerable Mainers harmed by fraud, or with the political networks that refuse to talk about it?
Former Lewiston City Councilor Safiya Khalid has also been mentioned by critics as part of the broader political ecosystem surrounding these organizations.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8ac4c713-f283-4571-b628-9a60cf4a5110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
TheMaine People's Alliance, one of the most powerful progressive activist organizations in the state, has helped empower many of the same political networks now facing public scrutiny.
Meanwhile, local and state leaders have largely stayed quiet.
That silence has become one of the most explosive parts of the story.
Gov. Mills, State Auditor Matt Dunlap, Senate President Mattie Daughtry, House Speaker Ryan Fecteau, and lawmakers including Deqa Dhalac and Yusuf Yusuf have all had opportunities to publicly and forcefully address the growing fraud concerns, nonprofit accountability questions, and MaineCare oversight failures.
Critics say they have not.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ef7defd-1551-4b24-94b7-14250d1157f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Why?
When elected officials know that questionable providers, suspicious offices, and politically connected nonprofits are operating in their communities, residents expect answers.
Instead, many Mainers have seen silence, deflection, or attacks on the people asking questions.
In Lewiston, the tension has become impossible to ignore.
At one city council meeting, a man identified as Mohammad warned councilors that if they failed to do what the Somali community wanted, they would be voted out.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/71cf1ca4-5b7e-43cc-8065-aa7077781b5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The comment quickly spread online and added to growing concerns about political pressure inside city government.
At the same time, Maine Wire staff, including Jon Fetherston, have been physically threatened, stalked, and subjected to handgun gestures during live broadcasts of Maine Wire TV.
That raises another question: why are journalists being threatened for asking where taxpayer money went?
Federal immigration enforcement has added another layer to the controversy.
Homeland Security and ICE officials have made clear that fraud, identity theft, illegal benefit schemes, and organized abuse of government-funded programs are major enforcement priorities.
In Maine, those issues now overlap with concerns about healthcare billing, nonprofit accountability, immigration enforcement, and state-level oversight failures.
That is why Vance's visit mattered.
It sent a message that Maine's fraud problem is no longer being handled quietly behind closed doors in Augusta.
It is now being watched by Washington.
The question facing Maine is no longer whether there is a problem.
Gateway had its payments suspended. Paradise Residential was shut down. Homeland Security visited Lewiston. The Maine Wire documented clusters of suspicious home health agencies. More than 140 agencies in Maine were found with Minnesota phone numbers. Zahraa Home Care was identified operating from a mobile home trailer in Windham. Federal officials are talking about Maine. Dr. Oz has put the state on notice. JD Vance came to Bangor and named the issue directly. Maine Wire journalists have been threatened while reporting on it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1d6e13-da3c-431a-9106-5f2bc9b7bdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So the real question is this:
How did so many elected leaders stay silent for so long?
And how long will Maine's legacy media continue treating a national fraud scandal as something to be minimized, explained away, or buried under the word "alleged"?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f9e7a486-1576-423e-abd9-5c603db54ca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For many Mainers, this no longer looks like a handful of isolated cases.
It looks like a system that was ignored until The Maine Wire exposed it, taxpayers got angry, and the federal government finally showed up.

Families were being destroyed.

And most people had no idea this evil even existed.

For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Friend...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **

I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

clean_body: The future of America’s young women is being decided now For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth. | | | | | | | Friend, For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth. And honestly? For a while, they did. They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities. They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful... That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase. But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened: Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years. And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations. For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War. But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: America 's young women. Because they know something very important, Friend... If they can win the hearts and minds of young women... They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations. And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events. And I can honestly tell you: I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now. Because modern culture is failing them. The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment." They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism. And after years of hearing those lies... So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty. They're searching for something REAL. Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down. That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage. From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: ✅ Strengthen their minds ✅ Cultivate wellness ✅ Step boldly into their purpose ✅ Anchor their spirits in faith And when they walk into that room... Something changes. Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time. Young women arriving unsure of themselves... Then leaving with fire in their eyes. Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing: " There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." That matters. Because the Left wants these young women isolated. Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate. But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger. A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. And these women don't just leave inspired... They go home ready to LEAD. I've watched women leave WLS and: 🔥 Strengthen their faith 🔥 Embrace their femininity 🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose 🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses 🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters 🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time. But here 's the problem, Friend... Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help. Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare. Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs. And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. But there 's not much time left before the doors open... I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life... That's why I'm personally asking: For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change. The moment they realize they are NOT alone. The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America. The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for. Because if we want to save this country... We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. That's the mission. And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next. Please help us make sure no young woman is left behind. Let's fill San Antonio with women ready to LIVE boldly... Stand confidently in truth... LOVE AMERICA again... And help WIN the American Culture War. | | | For Charlie, Lauren Toncich Vice President of EventsTurning Point USA P.S. The Left spent years convincing young women that faith, femininity, family, and patriotism were things to reject. Advocate for Life, The abortion pill was already sitting in her online cart when she found PreBorn!. She had spent most of the night scrolling through websites that promised an easy solution to her fear. Everything she read made the process sound clinical, detached, and uncomplicated—as though ending a pregnancy was no more significant than filling a prescription. But underneath the panic and late-night searching was a woman who felt completely trapped. She wasn’t thinking about politics. She was thinking about rent. About disappointing her parents. About whether the father would disappear if she kept the baby. About how alone she felt carrying a secret she didn’t know how to tell anyone. And like so many women today, she was being pushed toward abortion before anyone had even shown her her baby. [**That is why PreBorn!’s ministry is so urgent right now.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkUGu2zAMRE8j7xJIlC0nCy9auO7qF2hRtEuDoWhHqCQLkpyP3r5wkRzgLzkzeAQ5v9_mN3TexfUbBh5yXeZc5np3xZX3-9_d14xl26MtAWvlGSSYk-xO6nLkVGMHSxYVNTyovr-qVrfm0tyHDqTuF03XG_V60Wyt0d1NA11xkbKTjRsOlOzUBUAr2Z2hVa2hFpVciMhK0Ur0nOs5c9pv3hHGiuXPsmXiM22h8cO91lSE_iRgEjCt7sHnlPm25XgEBEzPScCEKTH6IvRUSOjxy1epwEyfBRgMVeixMwLMWoQe0Qowew1z2fZMLPSY8lYSU3VxfVqBrduD0CMHdP4pEoaEbo2H_OC8ZuY4w-XlbrFyPFb9gvl7f_rxczq9PtDkwaZ3570rphetXA_q_xvrxxt5DPAvAAD__y7CmXo) More abortions than ever are happening through pills ordered quickly and privately, often without an ultrasound and without meaningful counseling. The entire system is built around speed. Move fast. Don’t think too long. Solve the problem before the emotions catch up. # **The 2026 "Trump Effect"
on IRAs over $50,000**
---
**President Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” is exactly what this country needs.** It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s finally putting American families first. But we have to be honest with you about something that’s hard to say. **Trump’s new plan is moving fast** ... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle. Think of it like a powerful cleaning crew coming into a dusty old house. They are going to scrub everything clean, which is wonderful. But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. He is doing his job. **But the Wall Street banks holding your retirement savings are like those shaky tables.** They are old, tired, and not built for this kind of _**Economic Revolution**._ If you leave your money sitting there, it could get caught in the shake-up.
---
**This is why we hesitate to share this next part publicly.**
---
There is a way to move your **_financial heirloom_** to a safe room before the cleaning starts. It involves a specific, IRS-approved loophole that very few families know about. **To be honest, this loophole works so well it may feel a little unfair**. It allows you to quietly step out of the chaotic banking system to figuratively _**lock** _your savings into something that doesn't care about stock markets or bank failures. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. While your neighbors are glued to the TV worrying about the next market swing, you can turn the TV off, knowing your grandkid's inheritance is sitting in a sanctuary that Wall Street can't touch.
---
# **[We’ve written down exactly how to use this loophole inside our 2026 Patriot’s Wealth Defense Guide.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

This kind of protection is typically only whispered about by the ultra-wealthy. But with the speed of Trump's changes, we feel a moral duty to share it with those who need to help protect their families. **If you are an American Citizen with more than $50,000 in retirement, you may already be eligible to receive the benefits detailed in this free guide.** [**Note: We also currently have a Silver Allocation Incentive*.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Dear Friend, I'm going to be blunt: **antisemitism is evil.** And Americans cannot keep tiptoeing around it as if it's a "complicated issue" or a "different perspective."It's not.This isn't only a Christian issue. **It 's an American issue.** Israel is one of our closest allies--and the **only democratic, free nation in the Middle East.** When Israel is demonized and Jews are targeted, it is a moral test for the church and a strategic test for America. Israel and the Jewish people are under attack. And at the same time, antisemitism is exploding in public--on campuses, in streets, in comment sections, and on social media.Jewish people are being harassed, threatened, and targeted simply because they're Jewish. Synagogues are vandalized. Students are intimidated. And too many people are still playing games with words--rebranding hatred as "truth-telling," "edgy commentary," or "just asking questions."**Enough.** Some of the loudest megaphones pushing this poison are not anonymous trolls. They are public figures with massive audiences--people who traffic in antisemitic insinuations, conspiracy talk, and smear campaigns that dehumanize Jews and demonize Israel.That includes voices like **Nick Fuentes** , who is widely known for openly extremist rhetoric, and **Candace Owens** , who has repeatedly stirred controversy for amplifying antisemitic tropes and insinuations.When influential voices normalize antisemitism, it doesn't stay online. It spreads. It emboldens. It harms real people.Here's the hard truth: **silence is not neutrality. Silence is permission.** So what do we do? We speak clearly. We act decisively. We stand with the Jewish people--and we stand with Israel as a nation worth defending.If you're asking, "How do I respond with clarity--and not get shouted down or confused?" we want to put a strong, practical tool in your hands.With your gift of **any amount** , we will send you a **FREE booklet** :
**_Antisemitism: What Every Christian Needs to Know and How to Counter It_** This is not vague. It's not academic. It's built for real-life conversations. Inside you'll find:
---
* How antisemitism shows up today (often disguised as "criticism" or "conspiracy")
* Straight answers to common myths and talking points
* Biblical clarity to help you respond without fear, hesitation, or compromise

I wanted to get that out of the way first, because I'm no stranger to having tough conversations.
Back in 2024, I was the first national Democrat to say the quiet part out loud: **that Joe Biden was on track to lose to Trump in a landslide.**
Not because it was easy, but because a Democratic victory was incumbent on our willingness to honestly tackle real issues facing folks across the country.
Promising to fight MAGA – _although critically important_ – wasn’t going to cut it.
We had to offer people a vision for the future, and we failed.
Meanwhile, my primary opponent Phil Weiser – also a DNC delegate – was silent on Biden.
So as Trump's record-high inflation compounds the cost-of-living crisis that's pushing Colorado families and small businesses out of state, we can't afford to make the same mistake twice.
**The bottom line is that governors don’t get to sit on the sidelines until the politics are clear.** They have to make the tough calls, take responsibility, and stand up for what's right – even when it means standing alone sometimes.
Unlike Phil, I'm ready and willing to do that every day. I'm running for governor because at this critical moment, Colorado needs a fighter.
But with primary ballots soon to arrive in the mail, our grassroots movement has a choice to make: **e****ither we build the resources to keep our ads live and our message on voters' minds, or we allow Phil to dominate the airwaves and clinch the Democratic nomination.**
If we want to keep Colorado blue after Election Day, the latter is not an option.

Promising to fight MAGA – although critically important – wasn’t going to cut it. We had to offer people a vision for the future, and we failed. Meanwhile, my primary opponent Phil Weiser – also a DNC delegate – was silent on Biden. So as Trump's record-high inflation compounds the cost-of-living crisis that's pushing Colorado families and small businesses out of state, we can't afford to make the same mistake twice. The bottom line is that governors don’t get to sit on the sidelines until the politics are clear. They have to make the tough calls, take responsibility, and stand up for what's right – even when it means standing alone sometimes. Unlike Phil, I'm ready and willing to do that every day. I'm running for governor because at this critical moment, Colorado needs a fighter. But with primary ballots soon to arrive in the mail, our grassroots movement has a choice to make: either we build the resources to keep our ads live and our message on voters' minds, or we allow Phil to dominate the airwaves and clinch the Democratic nomination. clean_body: Add your name >> | | | = | | | I have news about our elections: Donald Trump just signed a new executive order attempting to reshape how Americans vote — overriding states, restricting mail ballots, and putting federal agencies in charge of decisions they were never meant to make. I’m Tobias Read, Oregon Secretary of State, and I’m sounding the alarm, because this is unconstitutional and it could fundamentally disrupt how our elections are run. This is not about “election integrity.” This is about control. States — not the White House — are responsible for administering elections. That’s not just tradition, it’s written into the Constitution. And when any administration tries to bypass that, we all have a responsibility to speak up. We’ve already seen courts step in to stop similar overreaches. And we know that when people raise their voices together, it makes a difference. But they’re counting on our silence. If we don’t push back now, we risk setting a dangerous precedent — one where federal power can be used to restrict access to the ballot box. — Tobias Read = | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Friends of Tobias Read (5208) PO Box 42307 Portland, OR 97242 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

Hi there, Last week, the National Education Association released a report that should break every Arizonan's heart: **Our state is ranked one place away from dead last in the country for student spending.** And instead of fixing this crisis, extremist lawmakers are doubling down on a vindictive plan to eliminate the very people fighting for our schools. They’ve introduced a union-busting ballot measure designed to legislate the state’s largest teachers union out of existence. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131648447/621836579/-7213939?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260518_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDIyYzAzNjEtMGQ1My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SbM5zvuz0dYscrYGTTTJ1NCtiU2CNJFLi_2tZ5SoswQ=) **[This is unacceptable. Please give what you can today to show that we’re not backing down and doing what we can to protect our teachers.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131648448/621836584/-7213939?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260518_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDIyYzAzNjEtMGQ1My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SbM5zvuz0dYscrYGTTTJ1NCtiU2CNJFLi_2tZ5SoswQ=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131648449/621836589/-7213939?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260518_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDIyYzAzNjEtMGQ1My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SbM5zvuz0dYscrYGTTTJ1NCtiU2CNJFLi_2tZ5SoswQ=)

As someone who stood on the front lines of the **#RedForEd** movement in 2018, I will never forget that sea of red. I remember 50,000 of us — teachers, parents, and students — marching through downtown Phoenix to the State Capitol. We were a sleeping giant that had finally woken up to demand that our state prioritize its children.
**[Today, that same spirit is needed more than ever.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131648450/621836594/-7213939?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260518_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDIyYzAzNjEtMGQ1My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SbM5zvuz0dYscrYGTTTJ1NCtiU2CNJFLi_2tZ5SoswQ=)**
**This isn't just a policy debate — it’s a direct attack on our classrooms:**
* **Stripping Rights:** The bill would eliminate collective bargaining and stop teachers from even using school email or classrooms to discuss their goals.
* **Harsh Penalties:** A single "organized work stoppage" coordinated by as few as two teachers could result in them losing their jobs and benefits.
* **The Veto Loophole:** Because this is a ballot referral, it bypasses Governor Hobbs' veto stamp and goes straight to the voters this November.

**Why are they doing this now?** Because teachers had the audacity to fight back against the $1 billion private school voucher program that is draining our public funds.
As Geneva Fuentes from the AEA recently noted, it was a local union that negotiated accessible playgrounds for students with special needs. It’s unions that fight for the retention bonuses we need to fix a shortage that left over **4,200 teacher positions vacant** this past year.
In my time advocating for Arizona’s families, I’ve learned _"It takes a village."_ We cannot improve working conditions or student outcomes if we are forced to stand alone.
**[Right now, we’re at a critical time, and we need your support to keep up this work. Will you donate $10 today to support our students and teachers here in Arizona?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131648451/621836598/-7213939?amount=10&refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260518_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDIyYzAzNjEtMGQ1My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SbM5zvuz0dYscrYGTTTJ1NCtiU2CNJFLi_2tZ5SoswQ=)**

clean_body: This is about whether we value the people teaching the next generation. | = Hi there, Last week, the National Education Association released a report that should break every Arizonan's heart: Our state is ranked one place away from dead last in the country for student spending. And instead of fixing this crisis, extremist lawmakers are doubling down on a vindictive plan to eliminate the very people fighting for our schools. They’ve introduced a union-busting ballot measure designed to legislate the state’s largest teachers union out of existence. = = | = As someone who stood on the front lines of the #RedForEd movement in 2018, I will never forget that sea of red. I remember 50,000 of us — teachers, parents, and students — marching through downtown Phoenix to the State Capitol. We were a sleeping giant that had finally woken up to demand that our state prioritize its children. = This isn't just a policy debate — it’s a direct attack on our classrooms: Stripping Rights: The bill would eliminate collective bargaining and stop teachers from even using school email or classrooms to discuss their goals. Harsh Penalties: A single "organized work stoppage" coordinated by as few as two teachers could result in them losing their jobs and benefits. The Veto Loophole: Because this is a ballot referral, it bypasses Governor Hobbs' veto stamp and goes straight to the voters this November. Why are they doing this now? Because teachers had the audacity to fight back against the $1 billion private school voucher program that is draining our public funds. As Geneva Fuentes from the AEA recently noted, it was a local union that negotiated accessible playgrounds for students with special needs. It’s unions that fight for the retention bonuses we need to fix a shortage that left over 4,200 teacher positions vacant this past year. In my time advocating for Arizona’s families, I’ve learned "It takes a village." body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240850%2E444211%2E5Z7v-c)
A few years ago, a student named Yovanka introduced Beto on stage at Texas A&M. On Saturday, I "ran into" her again...but this time through a Ring camera.
With campus traffic slowing down for the summer semester, Powered by People is launching brand-new pilots to meet voters exactly where they are. This weekend, that meant going door-to-door at an apartment complex in Houston.
I knocked on the door of an apartment, and a second later, Yovanka answered through her doorbell speaker.
We ended up doing a full voter registration check right there on the porch. We quickly realized she hadn't updated her address since moving to Houston from College Station, so I left a mail-in form on her windowsill and grabbed her cell number to make sure she gets successfully registered in Harris County.
It was only after we sorted all of that out that she asked who I was with. When I told her Powered by People, she completely lit up and told me the story about introducing Beto at the Rudder Auditorium. Even though we were talking through a tiny speaker, the connection was instant—and she's already excited to volunteer with us here in Houston.
**[You can actually watch the video of our Ring camera interaction right here!](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/67683?t=3&akid=240850%2E444211%2E5Z7v-c)**
That interaction is exactly why we do this work. We believe in the power of real connections—even through a doorbell. It’s the first step in building trust, fixing registration barriers, and ensuring people turn out to vote when it matters most.
[**Please donate $3 today so can keep reaching people exactly where they are across Texas. Our work is possible because of people like you chipping in what they can.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260518.cLjSSv&refcode=ema20260518-240850&t=4&akid=240850%2E444211%2E5Z7v-c)

More soon,
Aimee Prudhomme

Over the last ten years or so, conservative figures have been disproportionally targeted for assassination or other acts of violence by extreme left-wing radicals.

In 2017, Representative Steve Scalise, then a rising star within the Republican party was critically wounded after he and other Republican lawmakers were shot during the annual baseball game between Republicans and Democrats, a decades old tradition of sportsmanship, non-partisan unity, and patriotic camaraderie. The shooter, another radical Democrat opened fire on Republican lawmakers but was quickly neutralized by DC police; but only after critically wounding Congressman Steve Scalise and injuring several others.

Scalise's attacker was motivated and influenced by the same pervasive and polarizing rhetoric that demonizes conservative voices throughout America today. Over the past decade or so, a distressing pattern in American politics has emerged. From the President of the United States to Supreme Court Justices, just like Scalise, they've become targets of murder attempts, countless death threats, and other forms of violent acts. Yet despite the alarming trend, the same progressive Democrat faction that fuels much of the incendiary rhetoric seems content to wave it off as simple political differences.

None of these actions were random; they were a direct result of the Marxist media's amplification of the radical left's elected leaders.

Every one of the bad actors over the last decade was clearly motivated by Marxist progressive ideology; and emboldened by the complicit mainstream media. Many of the manifestos left behind by these politically radicalized nut jobs spell it out quite clearly. The left's reckless theatrics have twisted the minds of both young and old and the results are real-world consequences; Charlie Kirk's assassination being one of the most glaring examples.

Kirk's outspoken conservative, Godly stance and his ability to connect with young people, Republican, Democrat, and Independent alike, made him an especially desirable target for the Marxist progressive sponsored rancor, which is designed to sew discord and distrust amongst an already politically fractured nation.

If Democrats and their allies truly cared about the safety and unity of this country, they would recognize the power of their words and act accordingly. Instead, party leaders like Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer continue to double-down on the violent rhetoric of stoking anger whenever possible. When people are told repeatedly that their political opponents are dictators and evil, the leap from outrage to violent justification gets shorter. body:
Starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
| | | |
---
Peter
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11422?amount=5&t=8&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on Election Night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, recent polling shows me statistically tied with his handpicked candidate. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11423?amp%3Bamount=5&t=9&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11424?amount=5&t=10&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11424?amount=25&t=11&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11424?amount=50&t=12&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11380?t=13&akid=1465%2E124072%2ES1O3sr)
---
Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Hi friend,

Derek,
Democrats, Republicans, and Independents are asking the same question:
Why are we in the middle of another war in the Middle East?
My colleagues and I have been forcing votes to stop Trump’s illegal war against Iran, and we’re making progress. Last week, our War Powers Resolution was blocked for a third time — but the vote count was 50-49, the narrowest of margins.
Since this war began, 14 American service members have died, and hundreds have been injured. Thousands of civilians have died. And Americans are increasingly fed up with the prospect of another endless Middle East war, and skyrocketing gas prices here at home as a result.
Take Virginia: the price of gasoline has gone up $1.50 a gallon because of this war. Virginians buy 8 million gallons of gas a day, so this is a seriously significant bite out of people’s pocketbooks.
The Pentagon’s estimate of the cost of this war has already reached $29 billion — and it’s climbing every day.
This is what happens when you start a war with no clear rationale, no plan, no debate or vote in Congress, and no allies by your side.
At the beginning of this month, Donald Trump had the nerve to send a letter to Congress saying this war has been “terminated.” Try telling that to the millions of Americans watching prices rise with no end in sight.
Derek , I am continuing to do everything I can to force my colleagues to confront this head on. Every senator needs to go on the record, and this President needs to be held accountable for dragging our nation into this foolish and unnecessary war.
If you’re with me, I need your help to put public pressure on my colleagues in the Senate before the next vote on my War Powers Resolution. We’re so close to securing passage of this important legislation.
Add your name in support of my resolution to stop this illegal war. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/JSv9CUwtB0ysgLnZ4m0q2Q2]

| TO: Interested Parties FROM: Remington Research Group RE: 2026 Primary Election, CA-SD-04 DATE: May 18th, 2026
_KEY POLL FINDINGS _
_BALLOT TEST _ **In a head-to-head comparison of Republican viability, Alexandra Duarte is outperforming Marie Alvarado-Gil by nearly a 3-to-1 margin. ** **Duarte’s strength is particularly evident among the Republican base, where she captures 53% of the GOP vote, compared to Alvarado-Gil’s meager 20%. Among "Very Conservative" voters, Duarte leads Alvarado-Gil 59% to 18%. ** **Duarte shows consistent strength across the district’s diverse geography, leading Alvarado-Gil in every tracked county and nearly every State House District. Duarte’s lead is greatest in Stanislaus County, where she leads Alvarado-Gil 33% to 9%. **
Alexandra Duarte, Republican, Mother/Farmer: 27% Marie Alvarado-Gil, Republican, Senator/Educator/Farmer: 11% Jaron Brandon, Democrat, County Supervisor: 35% Undecided: 27%
_CONCLUSION_ The race in California’s 4th State Senate district is a two-person contest between Alexandra Duarte and Democrat Jaron Brandon, who currently leads the field with 35% of the vote. Marie Alvarado-Gil has failed to secure the Republican base, leaving her with no viable path to the General Election. Alexandra Duarte is the only candidate capable of uniting the GOP base. With nearly 44% of Non-Partisan voters still undecided and a quarter (25%) of Republicans, Duarte’s momentum makes her the definitive choice for donors looking to see the seat in Republican hands.
_METHODOLOGY_ Survey conducted May 14 through May 16, 2026. 601 likely Primary Election voters participated in the survey. Survey weighted to match likely 2026 Primary Election turnout demographics. Margin of Error is +/-4% with a 95% level of confidence. Totals do not always equal 100% due to rounding. ###

It's not like any of this pent-up anger was because in 2008, we had massive majorities, passed legislation on everything from raising the minimum wage to immigration reform to all the things that have gone wrong. We passed all that. But you see this thing called the filibuster, which does not exist in the Constitution -- because the Constitution says the Senate is a majority body -- created by accident by Aaron Burr, for fuck's sake, killed Alexander Hamilton in a duel. That's a guy who you'd want to follow. And for years, we followed him -- I don't know, it's just tradition. There are no parties in the Constitution, as you may know. They didn't want political parties. It was up to the presiding officer in the Senate. You know who that is? The vice president. We had those a few times. We had people named Joe Biden as vice president and Kamala Harris. They'd stood up and said, unconstitutional. We are not following it. That rule is nullified. And now we 're going to go forward and have a regular vote. And yeah, a parliamentarian might have objected. And yeah, they would have taken it to court. But that's what Republicans do every time. They make us take it to court. And who knows? A corrupt Supreme Court, even back then, may have overturned it. Even though the filibuster is absolutely anti-constitutional, as is the debt ceiling. We're required to pay our debt in the Constitution, but yet we let them hold us up every time it comes around, end up cutting Medicaid in price. You think people got pissed at us because of that? Because we weren't tough enough and we gave in on that garbage based on tradition and not based on the Constitution? So here we are. And so many Democrats -- I've named a bunch of them, and there are governors Pritzker, Newsom, who've learned this lesson -- but somehow you folks haven't. So you and Congress, you know, led by our weak leadership, Schumer and Jeffries, who couldn't message their way out of a fucking paper bag, we're just going to sit there and we're just going to let them do this, huh? I mean, the truth of the matter is that they are so sad, their numbers are so terrible, and it shouldn't have taken all of this if Democrats could message and if corporate media didn't have their heads up their arses. But I digress. Their numbers are so awful, they're like the Hungarian numbers. Those district lines are going to matter a lot less than you think, and they're going to gain a lot fewer seats than you think from cheating. But that's not the point here, is it? You give incentives and disincentives for how people behave. We incentivize Republicans to bully and punch us in the face every time. You know, my friend Joe Walsh, who I do a show on Thursday nights -- Tequila Talk , you should watch it, Thursdays at 6 p.m. (I wish I had a little more tequila right now.) He brought up the fact that in the cloakroom, Republicans used to go in there privately and laugh at Democrats, because they knew we didn't have the spine to stand up to them. And he said that numerous times. I didn't even need him to tell me that. I knew, because I'd be laughing too. I mean, if I were a sociopath, I'd be laughing at the other side of how weak they were. I, as a human being, laugh when the Republicans are weak and pathetic. But, you know... [TO BE CONTINUED] The audio to Cliff 's stream cut off here mid-thought. name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: In prison for saving lives? Not on our watch
body:
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6ba4d2fc6f1d4b8aa51cba1b7dd08c62&_e=x-3IDzJqSHDIK8Upz-Ke_qpo5IhVE5cCwCLy-H4WUh8K_Xx88Xs0pLt3o2s7BMnSCussyjEnMCZON8WmR1CjpsaXL54kEQ83x1ZwlIsXAcsrLlcyFTG04PdzK9-fFiYzNPxdkrvzwZUhqK0L8QuZulaePdZP2dRcGmVJlGGntCjklpLhZZ0ZDl_FlOj9RZRLNcGhh9GQTkyk5oOH0cc1PMTp3upeELO1zh0IM7x_TTmTK4uVIjehxu6GNRvKHxHb0hB12iltl4FBtzpDgtVAYSoX5PYPpydYV_PCZL0coReY7izdnLnPZPxlw7iaesDrGvaBD_bWeNJzouzKbmj9EpLmdEd7QpzzG34NRHljFTg4JA3j68UowdCBby973ENuex-RuMaUWMmQcKPy3gH-OlXtNuuVBEHy1qMUGeTw5y-1AwvVtVNDnwdbLgA_4BKl)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6ba4d2fc6f1d4b8aa51cba1b7dd08c62&_e=x-3IDzJqSHDIK8Upz-Ke_qpo5IhVE5cCwCLy-H4WUh8K_Xx88Xs0pLt3o2s7BMnSCussyjEnMCZON8WmR1CjpsaXL54kEQ83x1ZwlIsXActMYr1s6S-kRmAqKWodGbS4nGj1XePuxlflyrLNvH4JylwMlopIuFPdW3ObYa-alyK3oFsb_6-_P_sMItcfjJEaqTnzW5AiIy1J2c-VoUAI7x-jDVAQ9OCPgIkx7H4J3HKvTUtQvAgimBp7SALQrnUhbhqxEPC-uz2W2D-i08ZC3fhybu5XbkPx9XeBve67aAShEnce4oHF51Rr40aant-IKivSio0JToPlZsezK8jh1Sq8nu9A3vTnhbmo6AqXHhzPFO6zV8LMiq4RXSrKbU7u1Oey1mM3WzNfNo6Azsh_6qUf8ajZKTWnuIF0Dmvt0MWQ5gYkIZTEADLfEUg-avgC)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?
## Stand With Josh & Brandon
Every dollar goes directly to their legal defense and appeals. Help bring them home.
[Click Here to Donate](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=6ba4d2fc6f1d4b8aa51cba1b7dd08c62&_e=x-3IDzJqSHDIK8Upz-Ke_qpo5IhVE5cCwCLy-H4WUh8K_Xx88Xs0pLt3o2s7BMnSCussyjEnMCZON8WmR1CjpsaXL54kEQ83x1ZwlIsXActMOrL44qc4_jiARkNUcRkV22HUlM8Hpgx20DXCQ_C9vaqQLXFoH19ATZ9T_n18UFnmgRXADxZEpzA4eC9Y6wmmyFNLh6MrJfzyow-Wv746oIeYfj2_nS8ht70IxPh3Uvk3ry3rtgHISgmpIWmJiKIXoRCql7HSd8x1BSKBtmDxqQtJ882ntSy7vNjX41b4oQ7fxeYYzsmiTciSWBW0CLjPMSNfZQlcckINMNP7nc7wqH7NeR67jLhbTffQOuL1TL9IMnYxaSNoPxiD-Ev2Vr1vjZoy9mYlyeWNSFzB-zS4-p_jd4NTVK3uIRw387Qkt6UiK32WqpIpoH7fEU5W9fOo)
Your generous gift goes to defending these officers and restoring justice. No family should have to go through this. No officer should be imprisoned for doing his job.
Let's send a message: we still back the badge—and we won't let politics destroy the lives of our heroes.
For justice,
Sheriff Joe Arpaio (ret.)
National Center for Police Defense | Defenders for Justice

body:
Young voters who put Trump back in office are turning against the GOP.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260518-6254-footer&t=1&akid=6254%2E420207%2E80PRMH)
Peter,
**The tide is shifting with young voters — and it could change everything for our movement.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260518.VQvuki&refcode=em20260518-6254&t=2&akid=6254%2E420207%2E80PRMH)
The same young voters who sent Trump back to the White House are now getting crushed by rising gas prices, exploding health care costs, and a housing market that feels completely out of reach. All while billionaires cash in on more tax breaks from a government that can’t seem to do _anything_ for working people.
**Young voters are furious.**
They are tired of politicians who don’t see them, don’t hear them, and don't fight for them. So they are starting to turn on the GOP, and are looking for something better.
We can already see the shift. In special elections across the country, Democrats are winning big. The energy is real. The momentum is building. And now we have a real shot at taking back the House in November.
But momentum alone won’t win this election.
We have to organize. We have to knock on doors. We have to show up for our communities and make sure voters know someone is actually fighting for them. And yes - that organizing takes pitching in what you can so this moment doesn’t slip through our fingers.
Here’s the truth, Peter: I’ve spent my entire career fighting for exactly what these young voters are demanding for right now.
**Affordable healthcare, housing they can actually afford, an end to endless wars, and a government that puts working people first.**
I will continue to fight for that future, no matter what — but I need your support to keep me in Congress and see this through.

With gratitude,
